attributes.description: Indicates whether the pharmacy reimbursement contract is negotiated directly with the health plan (direct) or administered through the PBM intermediary (PBM-administered). Affects financial settlement, audit rights, and MAC list applicability.
attributes.references: PBM Contract Standards; ERISA; CMS Part D Pharmacy Contract Requirements

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the dispensing pharmacy record was first created in the PBM network master. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and regulatory record retention requirements.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164; CMS Part D Record Retention Requirements; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: dispensing_fee_amount
attributes.description: The contracted per-prescription dispensing fee paid to the pharmacy in addition to ingredient cost reimbursement. Expressed in USD. May vary by pharmacy type, drug type, or days supply. Commercially sensitive contract term.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Dispensing Fee Standards; PBM Contract Standards; NCPDP Claim Adjudication

attributes.name: dispensing_state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter USPS state code of the state in which the pharmacy is licensed to dispense. May differ from the physical address state for mail-order pharmacies licensed in multiple states. Used for state-level regulatory compliance and claim adjudication.
attributes.references: State Board of Pharmacy Regulations; NABP; HIPAA 45 CFR Part 162

attributes.name: doing_business_as_name
attributes.description: Trade name or DBA name under which the pharmacy operates if different from the legal business name. Used in member-facing directories and communications.

attributes.name: fax_number
attributes.description: Fax number for the pharmacy dispensing location. Used for prior authorization transmissions, prescription transfers, and clinical communications.
attributes.references: NCPDP Provider Identification Standard; HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164

attributes.name: ingredient_cost_basis
attributes.description: The pricing benchmark used to calculate ingredient cost reimbursement for drug claims. AWP (Average Wholesale Price) discount is most common for brand drugs; MAC (Maximum Allowable Cost) applies to generics; WAC (Wholesale Acquisition Cost) and NADAC (National Average Drug Acquisition Cost) are alternative benchmarks. Sourced from PBM contract terms in RxClaim/Argus.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Reimbursement Standards; NCPDP Claim Adjudication; MAC/AWP/WAC Industry Standards

attributes.name: line_of_business
attributes.description: The health insurance line of business for which this pharmacy network participation record applies. A pharmacy may have separate network records per LOB with different contract terms. Drives claim adjudication routing and formulary selection.
attributes.references: CMS Part D; Medicaid Managed Care Regulations 42 CFR Part 438; ACA Exchange Requirements

attributes.name: mail_order_capable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the pharmacy is certified and operationally capable of fulfilling mail-order prescriptions (90-day supply, home delivery). Drives claim routing and member benefit design enforcement.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Mail Order Pharmacy Requirements; URAC Mail Service Pharmacy Accreditation

attributes.name: ncpdp_chain_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Council for Prescription Drug Programs (NCPDP) Chain Code
attributes.description: NCPDP-assigned 4-digit chain code identifying the pharmacy chain organization. Used for chain-level contract application and bulk reimbursement rate assignment in the PBM system.

tag_set.value: National Council for Prescription Drug Programs (NCPDP) Chain Code

attributes.name: network_effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the pharmacy's current network participation status became effective. Distinct from contract_effective_date; captures the most recent network status change date (e.g., reactivation after suspension).
attributes.references: CMS Part D Pharmacy Network Requirements; PBM Contract Standards

attributes.name: network_participation_status
attributes.description: Current status of the pharmacy's participation in the PBM network. Drives real-time claim adjudication eligibility checks in RxClaim/Argus. Active pharmacies are eligible to dispense covered drugs; inactive/terminated pharmacies are rejected at point-of-sale.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Pharmacy Network Requirements; NCQA Pharmacy Accreditation; PBM Contract Standards

attributes.name: network_termination_date
attributes.description: Date on which the pharmacy's network participation was or is scheduled to be terminated. Null for currently active network participants. Used for claim eligibility validation and network adequacy gap analysis.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Pharmacy Network Requirements; PBM Contract Standards

attributes.name: network_tier
attributes.description: Pharmacy network tier designation that determines member cost-sharing levels and reimbursement rates. Preferred pharmacies offer lower member cost-sharing; specialty tier applies to specialty drug dispensing locations.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Preferred Pharmacy Network Rules; ACA Section 2707; PBM Contract Standards

attributes.name: performance_audit_provision
attributes.description: Indicates whether the pharmacy contract includes audit provisions allowing the PBM or health plan to conduct on-site or desk audits of dispensing records, pricing, and compliance. Required for CMS Part D sponsor oversight obligations.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Audit Requirements 42 CFR Part 423; PBM Contract Standards; ERISA

attributes.name: pharmacy_name
attributes.description: Legal business name of the dispensing pharmacy as registered with the state board of pharmacy and NCPDP. Used in member-facing communications, EOB documents, and provider directory.
attributes.references: NCPDP Provider Identification Standard; State Board of Pharmacy

attributes.name: pharmacy_type
attributes.description: Classification of the pharmacy by dispensing channel and operational model. Drives claim routing, reimbursement logic, and formulary applicability within the PBM system (RxClaim/Argus). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: retail|mail_order|specialty|long_term_care|compounding — promote to reference product if additional types emerge]
attributes.references: NCPDP Pharmacy Type Codes; CMS Part D Pharmacy Type Classification; PBM Industry Standard

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: Primary telephone number for the pharmacy dispensing location. Used for member contact, prior authorization coordination, and provider directory.

attributes.name: signature_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the pharmacy requires patient or authorized representative signature upon delivery for mail-order or specialty drug shipments. Relevant for controlled substances and high-value specialty medications.
attributes.references: DEA 21 CFR Part 1301; CMS Part D Delivery Requirements; NCPDP Claim Adjudication

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the operational source system from which this pharmacy record was ingested (e.g., RxClaim, Argus PBM, Cactus credentialing system). Supports data lineage tracking and reconciliation in the Databricks lakehouse Silver layer.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard; Databricks Lakehouse Architecture

attributes.name: specialty_accreditation_code
attributes.description: Accreditation body certification held by the pharmacy for specialty drug dispensing. URAC, ACHC, and NABP PCAB are the primary specialty pharmacy accreditation bodies recognized by health plans and PBMs. Required for specialty network participation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: urac|achc|jcaho|nabp_pcab|none — promote to reference product if multi-accreditation tracking is needed]
attributes.references: URAC Specialty Pharmacy Accreditation Standards; ACHC Specialty Pharmacy Standards; NABP PCAB; CMS Part D Specialty Pharmacy Requirements

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter USPS state abbreviation for the pharmacy dispensing location. Used for state-level licensure validation, network adequacy reporting, and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: USPS State Abbreviation Standard; NCPDP Provider Identification Standard; State DOI Regulations

attributes.name: twenty_four_hour_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the pharmacy operates 24 hours per day, 7 days per week. Used for network adequacy reporting and member access analysis, particularly for CMS Part D access requirements.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Network Adequacy Standards; State DOI Network Adequacy Regulations

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the dispensing pharmacy record was most recently updated. Used for change data capture, data quality monitoring, and audit trail in the Databricks Silver layer.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164; CMS Part D Record Retention Requirements; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: zip_code
attributes.description: US ZIP or ZIP+4 postal code for the pharmacy dispensing location. Used for geographic network adequacy analysis, member proximity calculations, and CMS Part D access reporting.
attributes.references: USPS ZIP Code Standard; CMS Part D Network Adequacy; NCPDP Provider Identification Standard

products.name: pbm_contract
products.description: Master record for PBM (Pharmacy Benefit Manager) contracts governing the relationship between the health plan and the PBM (e.g., RxClaim, Argus). Captures contract name, PBM vendor, contract type (ASO/full-risk/carve-out), effective date range, rebate guarantee terms, dispensing fee schedules, MAC list reference, performance guarantees, audit rights, and LOB scope. This is the SSOT for PBM contractual terms within the pharmacy domain.

attributes.name: pbm_contract_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the PBM contract record in the pharmacy domain silver layer. Primary key for this entity. Role: MASTER_AGREEMENT.

attributes.name: compliance_regulatory_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_obligation. Business justification: Regulatory obligations tied to PBM contracts; compliance team records which obligations each contract must satisfy.

attributes.name: contract_manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Contract management assigns a manager employee; needed for performance monitoring and audit of PBM contracts.

attributes.name: formulary_id
attributes.description: Reference to the drug formulary associated with this PBM contract. The formulary defines covered drugs, tier assignments, and utilization management rules governed by this contract.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Formulary Requirements; 42 CFR Part 423; NCQA

attributes.name: pbm_vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the PBM vendor organization in the health plan's vendor or trading partner master. Supports linking to vendor management records for credentialing and payment.

attributes.name: amendment_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent amendment or addendum executed against this PBM contract. Null if no amendments have been made since original execution. Used to track contract evolution and ensure current terms are applied in adjudication.
attributes.references: ERISA; NAIC; Internal Contract Management Policy

attributes.name: audit_frequency
attributes.description: Contractually specified frequency at which the health plan may exercise audit rights over the PBM. Relevant only when audit_rights_flag is True. Drives compliance calendar and vendor oversight scheduling.
attributes.references: ERISA; CMS Part D; NAIC; State DOI Audit Requirements

attributes.name: audit_rights_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the health plan has contractual audit rights to inspect PBM financial records, rebate calculations, MAC list pricing, and claims adjudication data. True = audit rights granted; False = not included. Critical for compliance and financial oversight.
attributes.references: ERISA; HIPAA; CMS Part D; NAIC; State DOI Audit Requirements

attributes.name: auto_renewal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the PBM contract automatically renews at the end of the contract term unless notice of termination is provided. True = auto-renews; False = requires affirmative renewal action.

attributes.name: awp_discount_mail_pct
attributes.business_glossary_term: Average Wholesale Price (AWP) Discount Mail Order Percentage
attributes.description: Contracted discount percentage off AWP (Average Wholesale Price) applied to drug ingredient cost reimbursement at mail-order pharmacies. Typically deeper than retail AWP discounts due to mail-order volume.
attributes.references: CMS Part D; NAIC; AWP Industry Pricing Standards

tag_set.value: Average Wholesale Price (AWP) Discount Mail Order Percentage

attributes.name: awp_discount_retail_pct
attributes.business_glossary_term: Average Wholesale Price (AWP) Discount Retail Percentage
attributes.description: Contracted discount percentage off AWP (Average Wholesale Price) applied to brand and generic drug ingredient cost reimbursement at retail pharmacies. A core financial term in PBM contracts (e.g., AWP minus 18% for generics).
attributes.references: CMS Part D; NAIC; AWP Industry Pricing Standards

tag_set.value: Average Wholesale Price (AWP) Discount Retail Percentage

attributes.name: cms_contract_number
attributes.description: CMS (Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services) contract number associated with the Medicare Part D plan under which this PBM contract operates (e.g., H1234 for MA-PD, S1234 for PDP). Required for CMS Part D reporting and RAPS/EDPS submissions. Null for non-Medicare LOBs.
attributes.references: CMS Part D; 42 CFR Part 423; CMS HPMS

attributes.name: contract_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the PBM contract (e.g., 'Express Scripts ASO Agreement FY2024'). Used for display in reporting dashboards and contract management workflows.

attributes.name: contract_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable contract reference number assigned by the health plan or PBM vendor at execution. Used for correspondence, audits, and regulatory filings. Maps to the contract identifier in RxClaim or Argus PBM system.
attributes.references: ERISA; HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: contract_owner_name
attributes.description: Name of the health plan employee or department responsible for managing this PBM contract relationship. Used for escalation routing, audit coordination, and vendor governance.

attributes.name: contract_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the PBM contract. Draft indicates the contract is under negotiation; active indicates it is in force; suspended indicates temporarily halted; terminated indicates early cancellation; expired indicates natural end-of-term; pending_renewal indicates renewal is in progress.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; Internal Contract Lifecycle Policy

attributes.name: contract_type
attributes.description: Classification of the PBM contract arrangement. ASO (Administrative Services Only) means the health plan retains financial risk; full_risk means the PBM assumes drug spend risk; carve_out means pharmacy benefits are separated from medical; pass_through means drug costs are passed at actual cost; hybrid combines elements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ASO|full_risk|carve_out|pass_through|hybrid — promote to reference product if additional types emerge]
attributes.references: ERISA; CMS Part D Prescription Drug Benefit Manual; NAIC

attributes.name: contract_version
attributes.description: Version identifier for the PBM contract document, incremented with each amendment or renewal (e.g., '1.0', '2.1', 'Amendment_3'). Supports contract lifecycle management and audit trail for regulatory examinations.
attributes.references: ERISA; NAIC; Internal Contract Management Policy

attributes.name: dispensing_fee_mail_order
attributes.description: Contracted dispensing fee in USD paid per prescription claim fulfilled through mail-order pharmacy channels under this PBM contract. Typically lower than retail due to volume efficiencies.
attributes.references: CMS Part D; NAIC; Internal PBM Contract Terms

attributes.name: dispensing_fee_retail
attributes.description: Contracted dispensing fee in USD paid to retail network pharmacies per prescription claim under this PBM contract. Part of the pharmacy reimbursement formula alongside ingredient cost (AWP/WAC/MAC).
attributes.references: CMS Part D; NAIC; Internal PBM Contract Terms

attributes.name: dispensing_fee_specialty
attributes.description: Contracted dispensing fee in USD paid per specialty drug prescription claim under this PBM contract. Specialty pharmacy dispensing fees are negotiated separately due to the high-cost, high-touch nature of specialty drugs.
attributes.references: CMS Part D; NAIC; Internal PBM Contract Terms

attributes.name: dur_program_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether Drug Utilization Review (DUR) — including prospective, concurrent, and retrospective DUR — is included as a service under this PBM contract. True = DUR services included; False = not included.
attributes.references: OBRA 1990; CMS Part D; NCQA; URAC

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the PBM contract becomes legally binding and operationally active. Governs when PBM services, pricing schedules, and rebate guarantees take effect. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: ERISA; CMS Part D; HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164

attributes.name: generic_dispensing_rate_guarantee
attributes.description: Contractually guaranteed minimum generic dispensing rate (GDR) as a percentage of total prescription claims. If the PBM fails to achieve this rate, financial penalties or credits apply. Key cost-management metric in PBM contracts.
attributes.references: CMS Part D; NCQA HEDIS; Internal PBM Performance Standards

attributes.name: governing_state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code of the state whose laws govern this PBM contract for dispute resolution and regulatory compliance purposes. Relevant for state DOI oversight, MAC transparency laws, and PBM regulation.
attributes.references: NAIC; State DOI Regulations; State PBM Transparency Laws

attributes.name: ingredient_cost_basis
attributes.description: The drug pricing benchmark used as the basis for ingredient cost reimbursement under this contract. AWP (Average Wholesale Price), WAC (Wholesale Acquisition Cost), MAC (Maximum Allowable Cost), NADAC (National Average Drug Acquisition Cost), or AAC (Actual Acquisition Cost). Determines the reimbursement formula for drug ingredient costs.
attributes.references: CMS Part D; NAIC; AWP/WAC Industry Standards; 42 CFR Part 423

attributes.name: lob_scope
attributes.description: Line of Business (LOB) covered under this PBM contract. Determines which member populations and benefit programs are governed by this agreement. A single contract may cover one or multiple LOBs. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: commercial|medicare_part_d|medicaid|exchange|all — promote to reference product for multi-LOB support]
attributes.references: CMS Part D; ACA; NAIC; 42 CFR Part 423

attributes.name: mac_list_reference
attributes.description: Identifier or name of the MAC (Maximum Allowable Cost) list applied under this PBM contract for generic and multi-source drug reimbursement. MAC lists cap reimbursement for generics below AWP. References the specific MAC list version maintained by the PBM.
attributes.references: CMS Part D; NAIC MAC Transparency Laws; State DOI Regulations

attributes.name: mail_order_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether mail-order pharmacy dispensing services are included in the scope of this PBM contract. True = mail order included; False = retail-only or carved out.
attributes.references: CMS Part D; NCQA; Internal PBM Contract Terms

attributes.name: mail_order_penetration_guarantee
attributes.business_glossary_term: Mail Order Penetration Rate Guarantee Percentage
attributes.description: Contractually guaranteed minimum mail-order pharmacy utilization rate as a percentage of eligible maintenance drug claims. Drives cost savings through mail-order channel incentives.
attributes.references: CMS Part D; Internal PBM Performance Standards

tag_set.value: Mail Order Penetration Rate Guarantee Percentage

attributes.name: performance_guarantee_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the PBM contract includes financial performance guarantees (e.g., generic dispensing rate, mail-order penetration, member satisfaction scores). True = performance guarantees included; False = not included.
attributes.references: CMS Part D; NCQA; URAC; Internal PBM Contract Terms

attributes.name: prior_auth_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether prior authorization (PA) requirements for specialty and non-formulary drugs are administered by the PBM under this contract. True = PBM manages PA; False = health plan manages PA internally.
attributes.references: CMS Part D; NCQA; URAC; 42 CFR Part 423

attributes.name: quantity_limit_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether quantity limit (QL) utilization management rules are in scope under this PBM contract. Quantity limits restrict the amount of a drug dispensed per fill or per time period. True = quantity limits apply; False = not applicable.
attributes.references: CMS Part D; NCQA; URAC; Internal UM Policy

attributes.name: rebate_guarantee_pmpm
attributes.business_glossary_term: Rebate Guarantee Per Member Per Month (PMPM)
attributes.description: Contractually guaranteed minimum rebate amount expressed as Per Member Per Month (PMPM) in USD that the PBM must remit to the health plan. A key financial performance guarantee in PBM contracts. Used for actuarial reserving and financial reconciliation.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Prescription Drug Benefit Manual; ERISA; GAAP; SAP

tag_set.value: Rebate Guarantee Per Member Per Month (PMPM)

attributes.name: rebate_pass_through_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of manufacturer drug rebates that the PBM is contractually obligated to pass through to the health plan (e.g., 100% pass-through vs. spread-based retention). Critical for MLR (Medical Loss Ratio) calculations and CMS Part D compliance.
attributes.references: CMS Part D; ACA MLR Regulations 45 CFR Part 158; ERISA

attributes.name: rebate_reconciliation_lag_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days after the close of a settlement period within which the PBM must provide rebate invoices and supporting data to the health plan. Used for financial close scheduling and IBNR reserve calculations.
attributes.references: CMS Part D; GAAP; SAP; Internal Finance Policy

attributes.name: rebate_settlement_frequency
attributes.description: Contractually specified frequency at which the PBM remits drug manufacturer rebates to the health plan. Drives cash flow forecasting, accounts receivable management, and actuarial IBNR (Incurred But Not Reported) rebate estimates.
attributes.references: CMS Part D; GAAP; SAP; Internal Finance Policy

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this PBM contract record was first created in the data platform. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and compliance with HIPAA record retention requirements. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164; NAIC; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this PBM contract record was most recently modified in the data platform. Supports change detection, SCD (Slowly Changing Dimension) processing, and audit trail requirements. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164; NAIC; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: renewal_notice_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days prior to contract termination_date by which either party must provide written notice of intent not to renew. Operationally critical for contract management and vendor transitions.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the operational source system from which this PBM contract record was ingested into the lakehouse silver layer (e.g., RxClaim, Argus, manual entry). Supports data lineage and reconciliation.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard; HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164

attributes.name: specialty_pharmacy_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether specialty pharmacy benefit management (high-cost biologics, specialty injectables) is within the scope of this PBM contract. True = specialty pharmacy included; False = carved out or not applicable.
attributes.references: CMS Part D; NCQA; URAC; Internal Specialty Pharmacy Policy

attributes.name: step_therapy_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether step therapy protocols are included in the scope of this PBM contract. Step therapy requires members to try lower-cost drugs before coverage of higher-cost alternatives is authorized. True = step therapy applies; False = not applicable.
attributes.references: CMS Part D; NCQA; State Step Therapy Laws; URAC

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date on which the PBM contract ends or was terminated. Null for open-ended contracts. Distinguishes between scheduled expiration and early termination when combined with contract_status. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: ERISA; CMS Part D; NAIC Model Regulation

products.name: drug_rebate
products.description: Transactional record capturing drug manufacturer rebate invoices and payments negotiated through the PBM. Captures rebate period, drug NDC, manufacturer name, rebate type (base/performance/market share), contracted rebate rate, utilization units, calculated rebate amount, invoiced amount, received amount, and reconciliation status. Supports MLR (Medical Loss Ratio) reporting and CMS Part D rebate pass-through requirements.

attributes.name: drug_rebate_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each drug manufacturer rebate record in the pharmacy benefit management system. Primary key for the drug_rebate data product.

attributes.name: drug_master_id
attributes.description: FK to pharmacy.drug_master

attributes.name: formulary_id
attributes.description: Reference to the formulary under which the drug's tier placement drove the rebate calculation.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Formulary Requirements; NCQA Pharmacy Standards

attributes.name: pbm_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the PBM contract under which this rebate was negotiated and invoiced. Links to the governing PBM agreement.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Prescription Drug Benefit Manual; ERISA

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the pharmaceutical manufacturer entity responsible for the rebate obligation.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Rebate Program; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: awp_unit_price
attributes.description: Average Wholesale Price (AWP) per unit for the drug as of the rebate period, used as the price benchmark for rebate rate calculations.
attributes.references: Medi-Span AWP; CMS Part D Pricing; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: calculated_rebate_amount
attributes.description: Rebate amount computed by applying the contracted rebate rate to the utilization units and applicable price benchmark. Represents the expected receivable before invoicing.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Prescription Drug Benefit Manual Chapter 14; GAAP ASC 606; SAP

attributes.name: contracted_rebate_rate
attributes.description: Negotiated rebate rate expressed as a decimal percentage of Average Wholesale Price (AWP) or Wholesale Acquisition Cost (WAC) per the PBM contract terms. Confidential as it reflects proprietary pricing agreements.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Prescription Drug Benefit Manual Chapter 14; ERISA; OIG Compliance Guidance

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this drug rebate record was first created in the data platform. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR 164.312; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this rebate record (e.g., USD). Supports multi-currency reporting for plans operating in US territories.

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded reason for a rebate dispute when reconciliation_status is 'disputed'. Captures manufacturer objections, utilization data discrepancies, or contract interpretation differences.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Prescription Drug Benefit Manual Chapter 14; OIG Compliance Guidance

attributes.name: dispute_resolution_date
attributes.description: Date on which a disputed rebate was formally resolved. Null if no dispute exists or dispute is still open.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Prescription Drug Benefit Manual Chapter 14; OIG Compliance Guidance

attributes.name: drug_tier
attributes.description: Formulary tier at which the drug was placed during the rebate period, which determines the applicable rebate rate. Tier placement is a key driver of rebate negotiations.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Formulary Requirements; NCQA Pharmacy Standards

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: Oracle Financials General Ledger account code to which the rebate receivable or cash receipt is posted. Supports financial close and statutory reporting.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 606; SAP; Oracle Financials Chart of Accounts

attributes.name: invoice_date
attributes.description: Date on which the rebate invoice was issued to the manufacturer or PBM. Marks the start of the payment due window per contract terms.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Prescription Drug Benefit Manual Chapter 14; GAAP ASC 606

attributes.name: invoiced_amount
attributes.description: Rebate amount formally invoiced to the manufacturer or PBM for the period. May differ from calculated amount due to adjustments, disputes, or rounding.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Prescription Drug Benefit Manual Chapter 14; GAAP ASC 606; SAP

attributes.name: line_of_business
attributes.description: Line of business under which the drug utilization generating this rebate was incurred: commercial, medicare_part_d, medicaid, exchange (ACA marketplace), or individual. Drives MLR segmentation and CMS reporting.
attributes.references: CMS Part D; ACA MLR Requirements; NAIC Model Regulation; DOI Reporting

attributes.name: manufacturer_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the pharmaceutical manufacturer obligated to pay the rebate. Retained on the transaction for reporting and reconciliation without requiring a join.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Rebate Program; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: market_share_pct
attributes.description: Drug's market share within its therapeutic class during the rebate period, expressed as a decimal percentage. Used to determine market share rebate tier attainment per contract.
attributes.references: PBM Contract Terms; CMS Part D Prescription Drug Benefit Manual Chapter 14

attributes.name: mlr_rebate_category
attributes.description: Classification of the rebate for ACA Medical Loss Ratio (MLR) reporting purposes: medical_cost_reduction (reduces incurred claims), quality_improvement (allocated to QI activities), or excluded (not counted in MLR numerator).
attributes.references: ACA MLR Requirements 45 CFR 158; CMS MLR Annual Reporting Form; HHS

attributes.name: ndc_code
attributes.description: 11-digit National Drug Code identifying the specific drug product (labeler, product, package) subject to the rebate. Formatted as 5-4-2 per FDA NDC Directory standards.
attributes.references: FDA NDC Directory; CMS Part D NDC Crosswalk; 21 CFR 207

attributes.name: part_d_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rebate is subject to CMS Part D rebate pass-through requirements. True for Medicare Part D covered drugs; False for commercial or Medicaid lines of business.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Prescription Drug Benefit Manual Chapter 14; 42 CFR 423.505

attributes.name: pass_through_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the received rebate amount that must be passed through to CMS or plan members per Part D or ACA requirements. Critical for MLR and CMS DIR (Direct and Indirect Remuneration) reporting.
attributes.references: CMS Part D DIR Reporting; ACA MLR Requirements 45 CFR 158; 42 CFR 423.505

attributes.name: payment_due_date
attributes.description: Contractual date by which the manufacturer or PBM must remit the rebate payment. Used for aging analysis and dispute escalation.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Prescription Drug Benefit Manual Chapter 14; ERISA

attributes.name: payment_received_date
attributes.description: Date on which the rebate payment was actually received and posted. Null if payment has not yet been received.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Prescription Drug Benefit Manual Chapter 14; GAAP ASC 606

attributes.name: performance_target_met_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contractual performance target (e.g., market share threshold, utilization goal) was met during the rebate period, triggering performance rebate eligibility.
attributes.references: PBM Contract Terms; CMS Part D Prescription Drug Benefit Manual Chapter 14

attributes.name: prior_auth_required_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether prior authorization was required for the drug during the rebate period. PA requirements can affect utilization volumes and rebate performance thresholds.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Prior Authorization; NCQA UM Standards; InterQual/MCG

attributes.name: rebate_invoice_number
attributes.description: Externally-known invoice number assigned by the PBM or manufacturer for this rebate billing cycle. Used for reconciliation with accounts receivable and PBM remittance.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Prescription Drug Benefit Manual Chapter 14; GAAP ASC 606

attributes.name: rebate_period_end_date
attributes.description: Last day of the rebate performance or utilization measurement period for which this rebate invoice applies.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Prescription Drug Benefit Manual Chapter 14; GAAP ASC 606

attributes.name: rebate_period_start_date
attributes.description: First day of the rebate performance or utilization measurement period (typically a calendar quarter) for which this rebate invoice applies.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Prescription Drug Benefit Manual Chapter 14; GAAP ASC 606

attributes.name: rebate_rate_basis
attributes.description: Price benchmark on which the contracted rebate rate is applied: Average Wholesale Price (AWP), Wholesale Acquisition Cost (WAC), Maximum Allowable Cost (MAC), or net price.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Prescription Drug Benefit Manual; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: rebate_type
attributes.description: Classification of the rebate by its contractual basis: base (standard formulary placement), performance (quality/utilization targets), market_share (volume threshold), formulary_access (preferred tier), inflation (price increase above CPI), or supplemental (ad hoc negotiated). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: base|performance|market_share|formulary_access|inflation|supplemental — promote to reference product if additional types emerge]
attributes.references: CMS Part D Rebate Program; NAIC Model Regulation; OIG Compliance Guidance

attributes.name: received_amount
attributes.description: Actual cash amount received from the manufacturer or PBM for this rebate invoice. Used for cash reconciliation and MLR reporting.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Prescription Drug Benefit Manual Chapter 14; GAAP ASC 606; ACA MLR Requirements 45 CFR 158

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the rebate invoice reconciliation process: pending (not yet invoiced), invoiced (invoice sent), partially_received (partial payment), received (fully paid), disputed (discrepancy under review), written_off (uncollectable). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pending|invoiced|partially_received|received|disputed|written_off — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CMS Part D Prescription Drug Benefit Manual Chapter 14; GAAP ASC 606; ACA MLR Requirements

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the operational source system from which this rebate record originated: RxClaim, Argus (PBM platforms), or manual (spreadsheet/manual entry). Supports data lineage in the Databricks Silver layer.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard; HIPAA 45 CFR 164.312

attributes.name: specialty_drug_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the drug is classified as a specialty drug, which typically carries higher rebate rates and requires prior authorization. Specialty drugs are subject to distinct PBM contract terms.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Specialty Tier Definition; NCQA Pharmacy Standards; PBM Contract Terms

attributes.name: step_therapy_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether step therapy protocols were in effect for this drug during the rebate period. Step therapy requirements influence market share and performance rebate attainment.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Step Therapy; NCQA UM Standards

attributes.name: therapeutic_class_code
attributes.description: Pharmacological therapeutic class code (e.g., GPI or ATC code) for the drug, used to aggregate rebates by drug category for formulary strategy and analytics.
attributes.references: WHO ATC Classification; Medi-Span GPI; CMS Part D Drug Data

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this drug rebate record was last modified in the data platform. Used to detect changes during incremental Silver layer processing.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR 164.312; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: utilization_claims_count
attributes.description: Number of pharmacy claims adjudicated for the drug during the rebate period. Used to validate utilization units and support audit of rebate calculations.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Prescription Drug Benefit Manual Chapter 14; NCQA HEDIS Pharmacy Measures

attributes.name: utilization_units
attributes.description: Total dispensed units (e.g., tablets, milliliters, grams) of the drug during the rebate period, as reported to the manufacturer for rebate calculation. Sourced from PBM claims data.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Prescription Drug Benefit Manual Chapter 14; RxClaim/Argus PBM Utilization Report

attributes.name: variance_amount
attributes.description: Difference between the invoiced amount and the received amount. A non-zero variance triggers reconciliation or dispute resolution workflows.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Prescription Drug Benefit Manual Chapter 14; GAAP ASC 606

attributes.name: wac_unit_price
attributes.description: Wholesale Acquisition Cost (WAC) per unit for the drug as of the rebate period. WAC is the manufacturer's list price and an alternative rebate rate basis to AWP.
attributes.references: 42 USC 1395w-3a; CMS Part D Pricing; Medi-Span WAC

products.name: specialty_drug_program
products.description: Master record for specialty pharmacy programs managing high-cost, complex specialty drugs and associated patient affordability programs. Captures program name, specialty drug list (NDCs), specialty pharmacy network, clinical management requirements, REMS flag, cold chain handling, hub services enrollment, and program effective dates. Owns all copay assistance and affordability program tracking: manufacturer copay assistance programs (copay cards), patient assistance programs (PAP), foundation grants, copay accumulator adjustment program (CAAP) interactions, benefit amounts applied, accumulator adjustment flags, and coordination with member out-of-pocket (OOP) accumulators. This is the SSOT for specialty drug management, affordability program administration, accumulator adjustment compliance, and CMS Part D specialty tier reporting.

attributes.name: specialty_drug_program_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the specialty drug program record. Primary key for this entity in the Silver Layer lakehouse.

attributes.name: formulary_id
attributes.description: Reference to the formulary under which this specialty drug program operates. Links the program to the applicable drug tier structure and coverage rules managed in the PBM system.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Formulary Guidance; NCPDP SCRIPT Standard

attributes.name: health_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the health plan or benefit plan under which this specialty drug program is offered. Links to the plan and benefit domain for coverage determination and member eligibility.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Prescription Drug Benefit Manual; ACA Section 1302

attributes.name: pbm_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the PBM contract governing the administration of this specialty drug program, including pricing terms (MAC, AWP, WAC), dispensing fees, and performance guarantees.
attributes.references: ERISA Section 408(b)(2); CMS Part D PBM Oversight Guidance

attributes.name: program_manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Specialty drug programs are overseen by a program manager employee; required for program governance and reporting.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: add column vendor_vendor_id (BIGINT) with FK to vendor.vendor.vendor_id - specialty drug programs often involve specialty pharmacy vendors

attributes.name: accumulator_adjustment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the Copay Accumulator Adjustment Program (CAAP) applies to this specialty drug program. When true, manufacturer copay assistance payments do NOT count toward the member's deductible or Maximum Out-of-Pocket (MOOP). Critical for CMS Part D compliance.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Copay Accumulator Guidance (CMS-4190-F); HHS Final Rule CMS-4190-F

attributes.name: awp_discount_pct
attributes.description: Contracted discount percentage applied to the Average Wholesale Price (AWP) for specialty drugs dispensed under this program. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.1800 = 18% discount). Governs ingredient cost reimbursement to specialty pharmacies.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Pricing Guidance; ERISA Section 408(b)(2); MAC/AWP/WAC Industry Standards

attributes.name: clinical_management_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether drugs in this program require active clinical management, including disease management, case management, or care coordination through the Care Management Platform (Casenet TruCare or Altruista).
attributes.references: NCQA Disease Management Standards; URAC Care Management Standards

attributes.name: cms_part_d_specialty_tier_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Part D Specialty Tier Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this program is reportable to CMS under the Part D specialty tier requirements. Drives inclusion in CMS Part D formulary submissions and Star Ratings (STAR) calculations.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Prescription Drug Benefit Manual Chapter 6; 42 CFR Part 423

tag_set.value: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Part D Specialty Tier Flag

attributes.name: cold_chain_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether drugs in this program require temperature-controlled cold chain handling and storage during dispensing and shipping. Drives specialty pharmacy network eligibility and logistics requirements.
attributes.references: USP Chapter 1079 Good Storage and Distribution Practices; FDA Drug Supply Chain Security Act

attributes.name: copay_assistance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a manufacturer-sponsored copay assistance program (copay card) is available for drugs in this specialty program. Triggers copay accumulator adjustment program (CAAP) evaluation logic.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Copay Accumulator Guidance (CMS-4190-F); OIG Advisory Opinion

attributes.name: copay_assistance_max_benefit_amount
attributes.description: Maximum dollar amount of manufacturer copay assistance benefit available to a member per program year under this specialty drug program. Used in accumulator adjustment calculations and OOP tracking.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Copay Accumulator Guidance (CMS-4190-F); ERISA Section 712

attributes.name: copay_assistance_program_name
attributes.description: Name of the manufacturer-sponsored copay assistance program (e.g., copay card program) associated with this specialty drug program. Used for affordability program tracking and OIG compliance reporting.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Copay Accumulator Guidance (CMS-4190-F); OIG Advisory Opinion

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the specialty drug program record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and regulatory compliance requirements under HIPAA and CMS.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164; CMS Data Retention Requirements; NAIC Model Audit Rule

attributes.name: dispensing_fee_amount
attributes.description: Contracted dispensing fee paid to specialty pharmacies per prescription dispensed under this program. Expressed in USD. Component of total pharmacy reimbursement alongside ingredient cost.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Pricing Guidance; NCPDP SCRIPT Standard; ERISA Section 408(b)(2)

attributes.name: drug_utilization_review_type
attributes.description: Type of Drug Utilization Review (DUR) applied to claims under this specialty program. Prospective DUR occurs at point-of-sale; retrospective DUR occurs post-adjudication for quality and safety analysis.
attributes.references: OBRA 1990 DUR Requirements; CMS Part D DUR Program Guidance; NCPDP SCRIPT Standard

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the specialty drug program becomes active and eligible for member enrollment and claim adjudication. Aligns with plan year or contract effective dates.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Prescription Drug Benefit Manual; ACA Section 1302

attributes.name: foundation_grant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether independent charitable foundation grants are available to assist members with cost-sharing obligations for drugs in this specialty program. Foundation grants may or may not count toward OOP accumulators depending on CMS guidance.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Copay Accumulator Guidance (CMS-4190-F); OIG Advisory Opinion 06-06

attributes.name: hub_services_enrollment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether members must enroll in a manufacturer-sponsored hub services program to access drugs under this specialty program. Hub services may include patient support, adherence programs, and financial assistance coordination.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Prescription Drug Benefit Manual; OIG Compliance Guidance

attributes.name: icd_condition_codes
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Classification of Diseases (ICD) Condition Codes
attributes.description: Comma-delimited list of ICD-10-CM diagnosis codes representing the covered clinical conditions for which drugs in this program are indicated. Used for prior authorization (PA) criteria and medical necessity determination.
attributes.references: WHO ICD-10-CM; CMS ICD-10 Implementation Guide; HIPAA Transaction Standards

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp

attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164; CMS Data Retention Requirements; NAIC Model Audit Rule

attributes.name: limited_distribution_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the drugs in this program are classified as Limited Distribution Drugs (LDD), available only through a restricted network of specialty pharmacies designated by the manufacturer.
attributes.references: FDA Drug Supply Chain Security Act; CMS Part D Formulary Guidance

attributes.name: line_of_business
attributes.description: The insurance line of business (LOB) under which this specialty drug program operates. Determines applicable regulatory requirements, formulary rules, and CMS reporting obligations.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Prescription Drug Benefit Manual; NAIC Uniform Coding Standards

attributes.name: mail_order_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether drugs in this program may be dispensed via mail-order pharmacy channels in addition to retail specialty pharmacies.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Prescription Drug Benefit Manual; NCPDP SCRIPT Standard

attributes.name: max_days_supply
attributes.description: Maximum number of days supply permitted per dispensing event for specialty drugs under this program. Typically 30 days for specialty drugs per CMS Part D guidance. Enforced at PBM adjudication.

attributes.name: oop_accumulator_applies_flag

attributes.name: patient_assistance_program_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a manufacturer-sponsored Patient Assistance Program (PAP) is available for uninsured or underinsured members enrolled in this specialty drug program.

attributes.name: prior_auth_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether Prior Authorization (PA) is required for all drugs covered under this specialty program before dispensing. Drives integration with the Utilization Management (UM) system (InterQual or MCG).

attributes.name: program_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the specialty drug program within the Pharmacy Benefit Management (PBM) system (RxClaim or Argus). Used in EDI transactions and CMS Part D reporting.

attributes.name: program_description

attributes.name: program_name

attributes.name: program_status

attributes.references: CMS Part D Prescription Drug Benefit Manual; Internal PBM Operations Policy

attributes.references: CMS Part D Prescription Drug Benefit Manual; NCQA Pharmacy Standards

attributes.name: quantity_limit_flag

attributes.name: termination_date

attributes.references: WHO ATC Classification System; CMS Part D Formulary Guidance; NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications

attributes.name: wac_discount_pct
attributes.description: Contracted discount percentage applied to the Wholesale Acquisition Cost (WAC) for specialty drugs in this program. Used as an alternative pricing basis to AWP in PBM contract negotiations.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Pricing Guidance; ERISA Section 408(b)(2); MAC/AWP/WAC Industry Standards

products.name: mtm_service
products.description: Record for Medication Therapy Management (MTM) services delivered to eligible members, as required under CMS Part D. Captures member eligibility criteria, MTM program enrollment date, comprehensive medication review (CMR) completion date, targeted medication review (TMR) date, pharmacist NPI, interventions recommended, medication action plan (MAP) items, follow-up status, and outcomes. Supports CMS Part D MTM reporting and STAR ratings quality measures.

attributes.name: mtm_service_id
attributes.description: Primary key for mtm_service

attributes.name: health_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Part D prescription drug plan (PDP) or Medicare Advantage Prescription Drug (MA-PD) plan under which the member is enrolled and MTM eligibility is determined.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Plan Benefit Package (PBP); 42 CFR § 423.153(d)

attributes.name: member_subscriber_id
attributes.description: Reference to the health plan member who received the MTM service. Links to the member master record in the core administration platform (Facets/QNXT).
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR § 164.514; CMS Part D MTM Program Requirements

attributes.name: mtm_program_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the specific MTM program offering under which this service was delivered. A plan sponsor may operate multiple MTM programs targeting different chronic condition cohorts.
attributes.references: CMS Part D MTM Program Requirements (42 CFR § 423.153(d))

attributes.name: pharmacy_dispensing_pharmacy_id

attributes.description: Number of qualifying chronic conditions the member has at the time of MTM eligibility determination. attributes.name: cmr_completion_date
attributes.description: Date on which the annual Comprehensive Medication Review (CMR) was completed for the member. CMS requires at least one CMR per calendar year for all enrolled MTM beneficiaries. Directly drives the CMS STAR Ratings MTM CMR Completion Rate measure.

attributes.name: cms_reporting_period
attributes.description: CMS Part D reporting period to which this MTM service record is attributed (e.g., 2024-Q1, 2024-ANNUAL). Used for CMS Part D MTM program reporting submissions and STAR ratings measurement year alignment.
attributes.references: CMS Part D MTM Program Requirements; CMS STAR Ratings Technical Notes

attributes.name: contact_attempt_count
attributes.description: Total number of outreach attempts made to the member to schedule or deliver the MTM service. CMS requires documentation of good-faith efforts to reach enrolled members. Used for compliance audits and outreach effectiveness analytics.
attributes.references: CMS Part D MTM Program Requirements; CMS STAR Ratings MTM Completion Rate Measure

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this MTM service record was first created in the data platform. Follows ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for audit trail and data lineage in the Databricks Silver Layer.

attributes.name: disenrollment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the member was disenrolled or opted out of the MTM program. Null if the member remains enrolled. Used to track program retention and calculate MTM completion rates.
attributes.references: CMS Part D MTM Program Requirements (42 CFR § 423.153(d))

attributes.name: drug_therapy_problem_type
