products.name: pa_decision
products.description: Transactional record capturing the authorization decision and underlying medical necessity determination rendered on a PA request. Stores decision date, decision type (approved, denied, partially approved, pended, withdrawn), clinical criteria applied (InterQual/MCG criteria set, version, effective date), criteria met/not met flag, clinical rationale narrative, ICD diagnosis codes supporting the determination, deciding reviewer NPI and credentials (MD, RN, PharmD), denial reason code and category (medical necessity, administrative, benefit exclusion, out-of-network, experimental/investigational), denial regulatory citation, appeal eligibility flag, and effective authorization period (start/end dates). Each PA request may have one or more decision records reflecting amendments, P2P reversals, or appeal overrides. Serves as the single evidentiary record for NCQA audits, state DOI market conduct exams, and denial defense.

products.name: hra
products.description: Health Risk Assessment (HRA) and Social Determinants of Health (SDOH) screening records completed by members — capturing assessment date, assessment type (HRA, SDOH screening), assessment version, screening tool (plan-specific HRA, AHC HRSN, PRAPARE, Hunger Vital Sign), completion channel (portal, phone, mail), risk score, risk tier (low, moderate, high, very high), identified health risks, SDOH domain flags (food insecurity, housing instability, transportation, social isolation, financial strain, education), community resource referrals, recommended programs, and assessment status. products.name: hedis_result
products.description: Single source of truth for HEDIS (Healthcare Effectiveness Data and Information Set) quality measure definitions and member-level compliance results. Contains the authoritative NCQA-published measure catalog (measure ID, name, domain: effectiveness of care/access/availability/utilization, measurement year, eligible population criteria, numerator/denominator definitions, exclusion criteria, data collection methodology: administrative/hybrid/survey) and member-level results indicating whether each member met numerator criteria for a given measurement year. products.name: psv_verification
products.description: Unified master record for each credential element held by a provider and its primary source verification (PSV). This is the SOLE authoritative product (SSOT) for ALL verifiable credential element types — no other product in this domain stores credential element data. Supported element types include: state professional licenses (MD, DO, NP, PA, RN, LCSW), DEA controlled substance registrations (with schedules II-V), specialty board certifications (ABMS, AOA, ABPS with MOC status), professional liability (malpractice) insurance (occurrence/claims-made, per-occurrence and aggregate limits, tail coverage), hospital clinical privileges (admitting, surgical, procedural, courtesy), graduate medical education and training (medical school, residency, fellowship, ECFMG for IMGs), and professional work history (5-year history with gap explanations per NCQA). Each record stores: element type discriminator, issuing/granting authority, element-specific attributes (number, schedules, limits, scope, restrictions), effective and expiration dates, current status, PSV source contacted (FSMB, AMA, ABMS, NPDB, OIG, DEA Diversion Control, state boards, facilities, carriers, ECFMG), verification method, verification date, verification result (verified, unable to verify, discrepancy), and verifier identity. One record per credential element per provider per application cycle. Core to NCQA CR 1-4 compliance.
products.reference: NCQA PSV Standards; URAC Credentialing Standards

products.description: Consolidated record for the full sanctions and exclusions lifecycle — both screening events and confirmed adverse findings. Captures each screening event (date, type — initial/monthly routine/triggered, databases queried including OIG LEIE, SAM.gov, state Medicaid exclusion lists, NPDB, screening result — clear/match found/pending review, resolution status) and each confirmed sanction, exclusion, or disciplinary action (sanction type, sanctioning authority, effective/end dates, severity, impact on credentialing status). products.name: contract_link
products.description: Represents the assignment of a vendor contract to a provider credential record. Each row captures the contract role (primary, supplemental, etc.) and the period during which the contract covers the credential.. Existence Justification: A credential record represents a provider's credentialing status with a health plan. Multiple vendor contracts can cover the same credential record (e.g., primary and supplemental credentialing services), and each vendor contract can cover many credential records across providers. The business actively creates, updates, and deletes these links and tracks role, effective and expiration dates for each coverage.

products.name: obligation_mapping
products.description: This association product represents the mapping between a credential record and a regulatory obligation. It captures the effective and expiration dates that define when a specific credential satisfies a particular regulatory requirement.. Existence Justification: A credential record can satisfy multiple regulatory obligations (e.g., NCQA, HIPAA) and a single regulatory obligation must be satisfied by many credential records across providers. products.name: finding
products.description: Represents the operational link between a provider's credential record and an audit finding. Each row records that a particular finding applies to a specific credential and captures attributes that belong only to this relationship.. Existence Justification: During audit engagements, auditors associate each audit finding with the specific provider credential records that are impacted. A single finding can affect multiple credential records, and a single credential record can be the subject of multiple findings over time. The link is actively created, updated, and tracked as part of the audit remediation process.

products.description: Transactional record for a provider's formal appeal of an adverse credentialing decision (denial, revocation, suspension). products.name: credential_attestation
products.description: Transactional record of a provider's signed attestation submitted as part of the credentialing or re-credentialing application. Captures attestation date, attestation type (initial application, re-credentialing, annual attestation), attestation questions answered (current competence, absence of impairment, no loss of privileges, no felony convictions, malpractice history accuracy, application accuracy), provider signature indicator, and any disclosures made. NCQA requires provider attestation within 180 days of credentialing decision. Each attestation submission is a distinct record.

domains.name: network
domains.description: Owns provider network configurations, tier assignments, in-network/out-of-network designations, geographic access standards, network adequacy metrics, and service area configurations. Manages ACO and VBC arrangement participation, network-to-plan associations, network directories, and CMS network adequacy filings. Distinct from provider identity (provider domain) and contract terms (contract domain); network owns the structural relationship between providers and plan networks.
domains.references: CMS Network Adequacy Standards, NCQA, NAIC

products.name: provider_network
products.description: Master entity representing a named provider network — the structural grouping of providers under a specific network product (e.g., HMO Narrow Network, PPO Broad Network, Medicare Advantage Network). Owns network identity, network type (HMO, PPO, EPO, POS), line of business association, effective/termination dates, geographic footprint, CMS network ID, NCQA accreditation status, and tier classification. SSOT for network identity — distinct from plan (benefit design), provider (provider identity), and contract (reimbursement terms).
products.reference: CMS Network Adequacy Filing — Network ID

attributes.name: provider_network_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the provider network. Primary key for the provider network entity.

attributes.name: ledger_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.ledger. Business justification: Needed to post network‑level financial transactions (fees, reimbursements) to a dedicated general ledger for audit and reporting.

attributes.name: network_vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.vendor. Business justification: Network Management Vendor Assignment report requires linking each provider network to its contracted vendor for credentialing and data services.

attributes.name: aco_participation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this network includes participation in ACO arrangements. True if ACO providers are part of the network, False otherwise.

attributes.name: cms_network_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Network Identifier (ID)
attributes.description: The unique identifier assigned by CMS for Medicare Advantage and Part D networks. Required for all Medicare networks. Format: one letter followed by five digits.

tag_set.value: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Network Identifier (ID)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this provider network record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date when this provider network becomes active and available for member enrollment and provider participation. Start of the network's operational lifecycle.

attributes.name: facility_count
attributes.description: The number of hospitals, skilled nursing facilities, and other institutional providers in this network. Used for facility access adequacy assessments.

attributes.name: geographic_footprint
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of states, counties, or service areas where this network operates. Defines the geographic scope of provider availability and member eligibility.
attributes.references: CMS Service Area Filing, State DOI Requirements

attributes.name: last_adequacy_review_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent internal or regulatory network adequacy review. Used to track compliance with annual review requirements.

attributes.name: line_of_business
attributes.description: The primary business segment this network serves. Commercial (employer-sponsored), Medicare (federal beneficiaries), Medicaid (state beneficiaries), Exchange (ACA marketplace), ASO (Administrative Services Only self-funded).

attributes.name: member_enrollment_count
attributes.description: The current number of members enrolled in plans associated with this network. Used for provider-to-member ratio calculations and capacity planning.

attributes.name: ncqa_accreditation_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Committee for Quality Assurance (NCQA) Accreditation Date
attributes.description: The date when NCQA accreditation was granted or last renewed for this network. Null if not accredited.

tag_set.value: National Committee for Quality Assurance (NCQA) Accreditation Date

attributes.name: ncqa_accreditation_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Committee for Quality Assurance (NCQA) Accreditation Status
attributes.description: The current NCQA accreditation status for this network. Accredited (full accreditation), Provisional (conditional approval), Denied (failed accreditation), Not Applicable (not seeking accreditation), Pending (under review).

tag_set.value: National Committee for Quality Assurance (NCQA) Accreditation Status

attributes.name: ncqa_expiration_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Committee for Quality Assurance (NCQA) Accreditation Expiration Date
attributes.description: The date when the current NCQA accreditation expires and renewal is required. Null if not accredited.

tag_set.value: National Committee for Quality Assurance (NCQA) Accreditation Expiration Date

attributes.name: network_adequacy_filing_date
attributes.description: The date when the most recent network adequacy filing was submitted to CMS or state regulators. Required annually for Medicare Advantage and Exchange plans.
attributes.references: CMS HPMS Network Adequacy Filing Requirements

attributes.name: network_adequacy_status
attributes.description: Regulatory assessment of whether the network meets time-and-distance and provider-to-member ratio standards. Adequate (meets all standards), Deficient (fails standards), Conditional (approved with corrective action plan), Pending Review (under regulatory evaluation).
attributes.references: CMS Network Adequacy Standards, State DOI Requirements

attributes.name: network_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code used to identify the network in operational systems, claims processing, and provider directories. Externally-known business identifier.

attributes.name: network_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the network's design, provider composition, geographic coverage, and unique features. Used in member materials and regulatory filings.
attributes.references: CMS Summary of Benefits and Coverage (SBC) Requirements

attributes.name: network_directory_url
attributes.business_glossary_term: Network Provider Directory Uniform Resource Locator (URL)
attributes.description: The web URL where members and providers can access the online provider directory for this network. Required for ACA and Medicare Advantage compliance.
attributes.references: CMS Provider Directory Requirements, ACA Section 1311

tag_set.value: Network Provider Directory Uniform Resource Locator (URL)

attributes.name: network_name
attributes.description: The official business name of the provider network (e.g., 'HMO Narrow Network', 'PPO Broad Network', 'Medicare Advantage Network'). Human-readable identifier used in member communications and plan documents.

attributes.name: network_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the provider network. Active (accepting enrollments and claims), Inactive (closed to new enrollments), Suspended (temporary hold), Pending (awaiting regulatory approval), Terminated (permanently closed).

attributes.name: network_type
attributes.description: The structural classification of the provider network. HMO (Health Maintenance Organization) requires PCP and referrals; PPO (Preferred Provider Organization) allows out-of-network access; EPO (Exclusive Provider Organization) no out-of-network except emergency; POS (Point of Service) hybrid model; HDHP (High Deductible Health Plan) network; ACO (Accountable Care Organization) value-based network.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Laws, CMS Network Standards

attributes.name: next_adequacy_review_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for the next network adequacy review. Typically annual for Medicare Advantage and Exchange networks.

attributes.name: out_of_network_coverage_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the network allows members to access out-of-network providers with cost-sharing. True for PPO and some POS networks, False for HMO and EPO.
attributes.references: Network Design Standards, ACA Essential Health Benefits

attributes.name: pcp_count
attributes.description: The number of primary care physicians in this network. Key metric for network adequacy and member-to-PCP ratio calculations.

attributes.name: pcp_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether members enrolled in this network are required to select a primary care physician. True for HMO and POS networks, False for PPO and EPO.

attributes.name: provider_count
attributes.description: The total number of unique providers (physicians, facilities, ancillary) participating in this network. Used for network adequacy calculations and member communications.

attributes.name: referral_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether specialist visits require a referral from the PCP. True for HMO networks, False for PPO, EPO, and most POS networks.

attributes.name: regulatory_approval_date
attributes.description: The date when the network received regulatory approval from CMS or state Department of Insurance to begin operations.
attributes.references: State DOI Licensing Requirements, CMS HPMS Approval Process

attributes.name: service_area_type
attributes.description: The geographic granularity at which this network is defined. Statewide (entire state), Regional (multi-county region), County (county-level), ZIP (ZIP code level), National (multi-state or nationwide).

attributes.name: specialist_count
attributes.description: The number of specialist physicians in this network. Used for specialty access adequacy assessments.

attributes.name: star_rating
attributes.description: The CMS Star Rating for Medicare Advantage networks, ranging from 1.0 to 5.0 stars. Based on quality measures including network access, member satisfaction, and clinical outcomes. Null for non-Medicare networks.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: The date when this provider network ceases operations and is no longer available for new enrollments. Nullable for open-ended networks. Existing members may have run-out periods.
attributes.references: CMS Network Filing Requirements, State DOI Regulations

attributes.name: tier_classification
attributes.description: The tiering structure of the network for cost-sharing purposes. Tier 1 (lowest cost-sharing, narrow network), Tier 2 (moderate cost-sharing), Tier 3 (highest cost-sharing, broadest access), Single Tier (no tiering), Tiered (multi-tier structure).

attributes.name: updated_by
attributes.description: The user ID or system identifier of the person or process that last modified this network record. Used for audit and accountability.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this provider network record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: vbc_arrangement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this network includes value-based care arrangements with providers (e.g., shared savings, bundled payments, capitation). True if VBC arrangements exist, False otherwise.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: The user ID or system identifier of the person or process that created this network record. Used for audit and accountability.

products.name: tier
products.description: Defines the tier structure within a provider network — Tier 1 (preferred/lowest cost-share), Tier 2 (standard), Tier 3 (specialty/higher cost-share), and out-of-network designations. Captures tier name, tier rank, cost-share differential rules, member-facing display label, and applicability by specialty or facility type. Used to drive member cost-sharing calculations and EOB generation. Distinct from contract fee schedules (owned by contract domain).

attributes.name: tier_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the network tier. Primary key.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: User identifier or system account that created this network tier record.

attributes.name: provider_network_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.provider_network. Business justification: Network tier definitions are scoped to a specific provider network; adding provider_network_id FK establishes the parent relationship.

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: Business identifier code for the network tier (e.g., TIER1, TIER2, TIER3, OON). Used in system integrations and member communications.

attributes.name: coinsurance_differential_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage coinsurance differential for this tier. Used when cost_share_differential_type is coinsurance or hybrid. Null if not applicable.

attributes.name: copay_differential_amount
attributes.description: Fixed dollar copay differential for this tier compared to baseline tier. Used when cost_share_differential_type is copay or hybrid. Null if not applicable.

attributes.name: cost_share_differential_type
attributes.description: Type of cost-sharing differential applied to this tier (copay, coinsurance, deductible, hybrid, or none). Determines how member out-of-pocket (OOP) costs are calculated.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this network tier record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: deductible_applies_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the plan deductible applies to services rendered by providers in this tier before cost-sharing begins.

attributes.name: display_label
attributes.description: Member-facing display label for the tier shown in EOB, member portal, and Summary of Benefits and Coverage (SBC). May differ from internal tier name for clarity.
attributes.references: ACA Summary of Benefits and Coverage Requirements

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this network tier configuration becomes active and applicable to member cost-sharing and provider network assignments.

attributes.name: facility_type_applicability
attributes.description: Defines which facility types this tier applies to (all, hospital, Skilled Nursing Facility (SNF), Durable Medical Equipment (DME), lab, imaging, pharmacy, home health, or custom list). Used to segment tier assignment rules by facility type. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: all|hospital|snf|dme|lab|imaging|pharmacy|home_health|custom — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: internal_notes
attributes.description: Internal operational notes or comments about this tier configuration. Not visible to members or external parties.

attributes.name: last_updated_by
attributes.description: User identifier or system account that last modified this network tier record.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this network tier record was last modified.

attributes.name: member_steerage_incentive_description
attributes.description: Description of any member steerage incentives or rewards offered for using providers in this tier (e.g., reduced cost-sharing, waived deductible, wellness credits).

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Official name of the network tier as defined in plan documents and contracts.

attributes.name: network_adequacy_credit_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether providers in this tier count toward CMS network adequacy standards and state Department of Insurance (DOI) access requirements.

attributes.name: oop_max_applies_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether member cost-sharing for this tier counts toward the plan Maximum Out-of-Pocket (MOOP) limit.

attributes.name: prior_authorization_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether services from providers in this tier require Prior Authorization (PA) or Utilization Management (UM) review.

attributes.name: quality_tier_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this tier is designated as a quality tier based on HEDIS, STAR ratings, or other quality performance metrics.

attributes.name: rank
attributes.description: Numeric ranking of the tier indicating preference and cost-share level. Lower rank indicates preferred tier with lower member cost-sharing (e.g., 1=Tier 1 Preferred, 2=Tier 2 Standard, 3=Tier 3 Specialty, 99=Out-of-Network).

attributes.name: referral_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether members must obtain a referral from their Primary Care Provider (PCP) to access providers in this tier. Typically applies to HMO and POS plans.

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier for the state Department of Insurance (DOI) or CMS filing that approved this tier structure. Used for compliance audit trails.

attributes.name: sbc_disclosure_text

products.name: adequacy_standard
products.description: Reference entity defining all network compliance standards by specialty, facility type, and geographic area — encompassing time-distance standards (e.g., 30 miles/30 minutes for PCPs), provider-to-member ratios, appointment access wait-time standards (routine, urgent, preventive, behavioral health), after-hours availability requirements, and telehealth equivalency rules. Captures regulatory source (CMS, state DOI, NCQA, URAC), standard category (time-distance, provider-ratio, appointment-access, after-hours, telehealth-equivalency), specialty category, geographic classification (urban, suburban, rural, frontier), maximum wait time in days, threshold values, and after-hours availability flag. This is the single source of truth for all network adequacy and access compliance standards — both geographic access (time-distance, ratios) and appointment access (wait times, after-hours). Used to evaluate compliance in adequacy assessments, access surveys, and CMS/state regulatory filings.

products.name: adequacy_assessment
products.description: Transactional record of a network compliance evaluation — including network adequacy assessments, access surveys, mystery shopper studies, and gap identification. Captures assessment type (adequacy, access-survey, mystery-shopper), assessment date, regulatory submission type (CMS, state DOI), specialty/facility type evaluated, provider counts, member-to-provider ratios, time-distance compliance results, wait-time measurements, survey method (member survey, secret shopper call), appointment type requested, telehealth offered flag, and overall compliance outcome. Includes detail-level gap findings as child records: specific specialty or facility type shortfalls within a geographic area, gap severity, number of providers available vs. required, remediation actions taken, and resolution status. Supports CMS network adequacy filings, NCQA HEDIS access measures (Getting Care Quickly), CAHPS survey supplementation, and targeted network development. This is the SSOT for all network compliance evaluations and their associated gap findings.

attributes.references: CMS Network Adequacy Standards, State DOI Requirements

attributes.name: exception_justification
attributes.description: Business rationale and supporting documentation for the regulatory exception or access plan waiver request (e.g., rural area with limited provider availability, specialty shortage area designation, alternative access arrangements).
attributes.references: CMS Network Adequacy Standards, State DOI Requirements

attributes.name: exception_request_date
attributes.description: Date on which a regulatory exception or access plan waiver was formally requested for this adequacy gap. Null if no exception has been requested.

attributes.name: exception_requested_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a regulatory exception or access plan waiver has been requested from CMS or the state DOI for this adequacy gap.
attributes.references: CMS Network Adequacy Standards, State DOI Requirements

attributes.name: gap_magnitude
attributes.description: Numeric difference between required and available provider count (required minus available). Positive values indicate shortfall. Null if standard is not count-based.

attributes.name: gap_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the adequacy gap, used for tracking and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: gap_severity
attributes.description: Severity classification of the adequacy gap based on magnitude of shortfall, number of affected members, and criticality of the specialty or service type. Used to prioritize remediation efforts.

attributes.name: gap_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the adequacy gap indicating whether it has been identified, is being remediated, has been resolved, or has received a regulatory exception or waiver.

attributes.name: gap_type
attributes.description: Classification of the adequacy gap by the dimension of network adequacy that fails to meet standards (specialty provider shortage, facility type shortage, geographic coverage gap, time and distance standard violation, appointment wait time standard violation, or essential community provider requirement shortfall).
attributes.references: CMS Network Adequacy Standards, NAIC Model Act #74

attributes.name: geographic_area_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the specific geographic area affected by this adequacy gap (e.g., FIPS county code, ZIP code, CBSA code).
attributes.references: U.S. Census Bureau FIPS Codes, USPS ZIP Codes

attributes.name: geographic_area_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the geographic area affected by this adequacy gap (e.g., county name, city name, region name).

attributes.name: geographic_area_type
attributes.description: Type of geographic unit used to define the area affected by this adequacy gap (county, ZIP code, Core-Based Statistical Area, service area, or custom region).
attributes.references: CMS Network Adequacy Standards, U.S. Census Bureau Geographic Standards

attributes.name: identified_date
attributes.description: Date on which this network adequacy gap was first identified during an adequacy assessment.

attributes.name: lob
attributes.description: Line of business to which this adequacy gap applies (Commercial, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, Marketplace/Exchange, or Dual Eligible Special Needs Plan). Different LOBs may have different adequacy standards.
attributes.references: CMS Network Adequacy Standards, State DOI Requirements

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional free-text notes, context, or commentary regarding this adequacy gap, remediation efforts, or regulatory interactions.

attributes.name: plan_year
attributes.description: Calendar year for which this adequacy gap applies and must be remediated (e.g., 2024, 2025). Network adequacy is assessed and certified annually.
attributes.references: CMS Network Adequacy Standards, ACA Section 1311

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this adequacy gap must be disclosed in regulatory filings to CMS, state DOI, or other governing bodies (e.g., QHP certification, network adequacy annual report).
attributes.references: CMS Network Adequacy Standards, ACA Section 1311, State DOI Requirements

attributes.name: remediation_action
attributes.description: Description of the corrective action plan or strategy being implemented to close this adequacy gap (e.g., targeted provider recruitment, contract expansion, telehealth deployment, access plan exception request).
attributes.references: CMS Network Adequacy Standards, State DOI Requirements

attributes.name: remediation_owner
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the individual, team, or department responsible for executing the remediation action and closing this adequacy gap.

attributes.name: required_provider_count
attributes.description: Number of providers or facilities of the specified type required to meet the adequacy standard in this geographic area. Null if standard is not count-based.

attributes.name: specialty_code
attributes.description: Standard taxonomy code for the provider specialty or facility type that is deficient (e.g., NUCC taxonomy code for specialty providers, facility type code for facilities). Null if gap is not specialty-specific.
attributes.references: NUCC Health Care Provider Taxonomy, CMS Provider Specialty Codes

attributes.name: specialty_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the provider specialty or facility type that is deficient (e.g., Cardiology, Skilled Nursing Facility, Primary Care Physician). Null if gap is not specialty-specific.

attributes.name: standard_threshold
attributes.description: The regulatory or contractual adequacy standard threshold that must be met (e.g., '30 miles or 30 minutes', '1 PCP per 2000 members', '95% within 10 business days'). Format varies by standard type.
attributes.references: CMS Network Adequacy Standards, State DOI Requirements

attributes.name: standard_type
attributes.description: Type of network adequacy standard that this gap violates (time and distance, provider-to-member ratio, appointment availability, or essential community provider percentage requirement).
attributes.references: CMS Network Adequacy Standards, NAIC Model Act #74, ACA Section 1311

attributes.name: target_resolution_date
attributes.description: Planned date by which this adequacy gap is expected to be resolved or mitigated to meet the applicable standard.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this adequacy gap record was last modified in the system.

products.name: provider_directory
products.description: Published provider directory record representing the member-facing view of a provider's network participation, including full verification lifecycle tracking. Captures provider name, specialty, practice location, phone, accepting-new-patients status, telehealth availability, languages spoken, accessibility features (ADA compliance), last verified date, and directory publication channel (online, print, API). Embeds complete verification history as child records — including verification method (outbound call, online attestation, EHR/HIE data match, claims-based inference), verification date, verified fields (address, phone, accepting-new-patients, specialty), verification outcome (confirmed, updated, unable to reach), and verifying agent/system. Supports CMS directory accuracy requirements (42 CFR 422.111), No Surprises Act compliance, the 90-day directory update mandate, and quarterly verification tracking. This is the SSOT for member-facing directory data and its verification audit trail.
products.reference: CMS Provider Directory — 42 CFR 422.111 / No Surprises Act

attributes.name: provider_directory_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the provider directory record. Primary key for the published provider directory entry representing the member-facing view of a provider's network participation.

attributes.name: directory_vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.vendor. Business justification: Provider Directory Vendor Management ensures directory data is sourced from a specific vendor, required for compliance audit.

attributes.name: maintaining_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Provider Directory Maintenance: assigns an employee who updates directory entries, required for data quality and audit trails.

attributes.name: provider_id
attributes.description: Reference to the provider master record. Links this directory entry to the provider identity in the provider domain.

attributes.name: provider_network_id
attributes.description: Reference to the network configuration. Identifies which network this provider participates in for member directory searches.

attributes.name: accepting_new_patients_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider is currently accepting new patients. Critical field for member directory searches and CMS directory accuracy compliance.

attributes.name: accessibility_features
attributes.description: Description of specific accessibility features available at the practice location, such as wheelchair ramps, accessible parking, or assistive listening devices.

attributes.name: ada_compliant_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the practice location is ADA-compliant and accessible to individuals with disabilities. Supports member searches for accessible facilities.
attributes.references: Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA), Section 1557 ACA

tag_set.value: Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Compliant Flag

attributes.name: address_line_1
attributes.description: Primary street address of the practice location. First line of the physical address where the provider sees patients.

attributes.name: address_line_2
attributes.description: Secondary address information such as suite, floor, or building number. Optional address component for practice location.

attributes.name: board_certification_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider is board-certified in their specialty. Used for quality assessment and member directory filtering.

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City name of the practice location. Used for geographic search and network adequacy reporting.

attributes.name: county
attributes.description: County name of the practice location. Used for CMS network adequacy reporting and geographic access standards.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this provider directory record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: data_quality_score
attributes.description: Calculated data quality score for this directory entry based on completeness, accuracy, and recency of verification. Range 0.00 to 100.00. Supports directory quality monitoring.

attributes.name: directory_publication_channel
attributes.description: The channel through which this directory entry is published and accessible to members. Supports multi-channel directory distribution tracking.

attributes.name: directory_status
attributes.description: Current status of the provider directory entry. Indicates whether the entry is actively published, pending verification, or suspended from member-facing display.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this provider directory entry was terminated or became inactive. Null for currently active entries. Supports historical directory analysis.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this provider directory entry became effective and available for member searches. Supports historical tracking of directory changes.

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Email contact for the practice location. Used for electronic communication and directory verification outreach.

attributes.name: fax_number
attributes.description: Fax number for the practice location. Used for prior authorization and medical records transmission.

attributes.name: gender
attributes.description: Gender of the provider. Used for member preference-based directory searches, particularly for gender-specific care.

attributes.name: hospital_affiliation
attributes.description: Name of the hospital or health system with which the provider has admitting privileges or affiliation. Supports continuity of care and member decision-making.

attributes.name: languages_spoken
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of languages spoken by the provider or available at the practice location. Supports culturally competent care and member language preference searches.
attributes.references: CMS Cultural Competency Standards, Section 1557 ACA

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this provider directory record was last modified. Supports change tracking and audit compliance.

attributes.name: last_verification_method
attributes.description: Method used for the most recent directory verification. Tracks how the provider information was validated for audit and compliance purposes.

attributes.name: last_verification_outcome
attributes.description: Outcome of the most recent verification attempt. Indicates whether information was confirmed, updated, or if verification was unsuccessful.

attributes.name: last_verified_date
attributes.description: Date when the provider directory information was last verified. Critical for CMS 90-day directory update mandate and No Surprises Act compliance.
attributes.references: CMS Directory Accuracy Requirements, 42 CFR 422.111, No Surprises Act

attributes.name: next_verification_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the next directory verification must be completed. Supports compliance with CMS 90-day update mandate and quarterly verification tracking.

attributes.name: npi
attributes.description: The 10-digit National Provider Identifier assigned by CMS. Used for provider identification in claims and directory searches.

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: Primary contact phone number for the practice location. Ten-digit phone number displayed in member directory for appointment scheduling.

attributes.name: practice_location_name
attributes.description: Name of the practice location or facility where the provider sees patients. Displayed in member directory for location identification.

attributes.name: specialty_primary
attributes.description: The primary medical specialty or taxonomy classification of the provider. Used for member search and filtering in the directory.

attributes.name: specialty_secondary
attributes.description: Additional specialty or sub-specialty of the provider. Supports multi-specialty provider directory searches.

attributes.name: state
attributes.description: Two-letter state abbreviation of the practice location. Used for geographic filtering and state-level network adequacy compliance.
attributes.references: USPS State Abbreviations, CMS Network Adequacy Standards

attributes.name: telehealth_available_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider offers telehealth or virtual visit services. Supports member search for remote care options.

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: Reason why the provider directory entry was terminated or inactivated. Examples include provider left network, practice closed, or data quality issue.

attributes.name: verified_fields
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of fields that were verified during the last verification event. Examples include address, phone, accepting_new_patients, specialty.

attributes.name: verifying_agent
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the person or system that performed the last verification. Used for audit trail and quality assurance.

attributes.name: website_url
attributes.description: Website address for the provider or practice location. Displayed in member directory for additional provider information.

attributes.name: zip_code
attributes.description: Five-digit or nine-digit ZIP code of the practice location. Used for proximity-based member searches and geographic access analysis.

products.name: vbc_arrangement
products.description: Master entity representing Value-Based Care (VBC) programs and their participation arrangements — covering both program design (program type, sponsoring entity, quality measure set, risk model, benchmark methodology) and specific ACO/VBC participation instances (ACO name, CMS ACO ID, arrangement dates, shared savings/risk terms, participating provider groups). Supports MSSP, Next Gen, REACH, commercial P4P, episode-based payment, and capitation models. Records may represent a program definition (template) or a specific arrangement instance (participation record), distinguished by record type. Owned by the network domain as the structural participation record — financial settlement terms are owned by the contract domain.
products.reference: CMS ACO — Medicare Shared Savings Program (MSSP)

attributes.name: vbc_arrangement_id
attributes.description: Primary key for vbc_arrangement

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Tracks VBC shared‑savings and risk‑adjustment costs against a specific cost center for financial consolidation.

attributes.name: vbc_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.vbc_program. Business justification: A VBC arrangement implements a defined VBC program; adding vbc_program_id FK ties arrangement to its program definition.

attributes.name: arrangement_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the VBC arrangement or ACO program (e.g., 'Metro Health ACO MSSP Track 1', 'Regional P4P Quality Incentive Program').

attributes.name: arrangement_number
attributes.description: Business identifier or contract number assigned to this VBC arrangement. Externally-known reference used in communications with providers and CMS.

attributes.name: arrangement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the VBC arrangement. Tracks progression from draft through active participation to termination or completion.

attributes.name: arrangement_type
attributes.description: Classification of the VBC arrangement model. Distinguishes between Medicare Shared Savings Program (MSSP) tracks, Next Generation ACO, Realizing Equity Access and Community Health (REACH) ACO, commercial pay-for-performance (P4P), episode-based payment, capitation, bundled payment, or other VBC models. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: mssp_track_1|mssp_track_2|mssp_track_3|next_gen_aco|reach_aco|commercial_p4p|episode_based_payment|capitation|bundled_payment|other — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CMS Innovation Center VBC Model Taxonomy

attributes.name: attributed_member_count
attributes.description: Number of health plan members or Medicare beneficiaries attributed to this ACO or VBC arrangement for the performance period. Used for PMPM calculations and risk adjustment.

attributes.name: attribution_methodology
attributes.description: Method used to assign members to the ACO or provider group. Prospective assigns at year start; retrospective assigns at year end based on utilization; voluntary alignment allows member choice; claims-based uses historical claims patterns.

attributes.name: benchmark_amount
attributes.description: Target cost or quality benchmark value established for the performance period. Expressed in dollars for cost benchmarks or as a quality score for quality benchmarks.

attributes.name: benchmark_methodology
attributes.description: Method used to establish the cost or quality benchmark against which performance is measured. Options include historical baseline (prior year costs), regional average, national trend, risk-adjusted PMPM, or episode target price.

attributes.name: care_coordination_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the VBC arrangement requires formal care coordination programs (care management, transitional care, chronic disease management). True if required; False if optional or not applicable.

attributes.name: cms_aco_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) ACO ID
attributes.description: CMS-assigned identifier for Medicare Shared Savings Program (MSSP) or other federally-recognized ACO arrangements. Null for commercial VBC programs.

tag_set.value: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) ACO ID

attributes.name: cms_reporting_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this arrangement requires formal reporting to Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS). True for all Medicare ACOs; False for commercial-only VBC programs.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this VBC arrangement record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: data_sharing_agreement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal data sharing agreement exists between the health plan and the ACO or provider group for claims, clinical, and quality data exchange. True if agreement is in place; False otherwise.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the VBC arrangement ends or is scheduled to end. Null for open-ended arrangements. Aligns with CMS performance year end for Medicare ACOs.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the VBC arrangement becomes active and performance measurement begins. Aligns with CMS performance year start for Medicare ACOs.

attributes.name: health_it_certification_required_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Information Technology (IT) Certification Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether participating providers must use certified Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems and meet health IT standards. True if required; False if not required.

tag_set.value: Health Information Technology (IT) Certification Required Flag

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this VBC arrangement record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: minimum_loss_rate
attributes.description: Minimum percentage of cost overruns before shared losses are assessed. Provides a buffer zone for two-sided risk arrangements.
attributes.references: CMS MSSP Minimum Loss Rate Standards

attributes.name: minimum_savings_rate
attributes.description: Minimum percentage of cost savings required before shared savings are paid. Acts as a threshold to ensure savings are statistically significant.
attributes.references: CMS MSSP Minimum Savings Rate Standards

attributes.name: participating_aco_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the Accountable Care Organization or provider group participating in this VBC arrangement. Null for program template records.

attributes.name: participating_provider_count
attributes.description: Number of individual providers (physicians, specialists, facilities) participating in this ACO or VBC arrangement. Used for network adequacy and capacity planning.

attributes.name: participating_tin
attributes.description: Tax Identification Number of the participating ACO or provider organization. Used for financial settlement and IRS reporting.

attributes.name: performance_guarantee_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of financial guarantee or bond required from the ACO or provider group to participate in two-sided risk arrangements. Ensures ability to repay shared losses.

attributes.name: performance_year
attributes.description: Calendar year for which performance is measured and financial reconciliation is calculated. Aligns with CMS performance year for Medicare ACOs.

attributes.name: primary_care_physician_count
attributes.description: Number of primary care physicians participating in this ACO or VBC arrangement. Critical for attribution and care coordination requirements.

attributes.name: quality_measure_set
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the quality measure set used to evaluate clinical performance (e.g., 'CMS ACO Quality Measures', 'HEDIS Comprehensive', 'Custom Commercial P4P Measures').
attributes.references: CMS ACO Quality Reporting Standards, NCQA HEDIS

attributes.name: quality_performance_threshold
attributes.description: Minimum quality performance score required to earn shared savings or avoid penalties. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 70.00 for 70th percentile).

attributes.name: reconciliation_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which financial performance is reconciled and shared savings or losses are calculated and settled. Most Medicare ACOs reconcile annually; commercial arrangements may reconcile more frequently.

attributes.name: record_type
attributes.description: Distinguishes whether this record represents a program definition template (reusable VBC program design) or a specific participation instance (actual arrangement with a provider group or ACO).

attributes.name: risk_model
attributes.description: Financial risk-sharing model of the arrangement. One-sided risk allows shared savings only; two-sided risk includes shared savings and losses; upside-only is gain-sharing; downside risk is penalty-only; full capitation transfers all risk.

attributes.name: service_area_description
attributes.description: Geographic description of the service area covered by this VBC arrangement (e.g., 'Statewide California', 'Metro Atlanta Region', 'National Medicare Population').

attributes.name: shared_loss_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of cost overruns above benchmark that the ACO or provider group is responsible for under two-sided risk models. Null for one-sided risk arrangements.

attributes.name: shared_savings_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of cost savings below benchmark that the ACO or provider group earns as shared savings. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 50.00 for 50%).

attributes.name: specialist_physician_count
attributes.description: Number of specialist physicians participating in this ACO or VBC arrangement. Used for network adequacy and specialty care access analysis.

attributes.name: sponsoring_entity_name
attributes.description: Name of the organization sponsoring or administering the VBC program (e.g., health plan name, CMS for federal programs, employer group for commercial arrangements).

attributes.name: stop_loss_limit
attributes.description: Maximum financial loss amount the ACO or provider group is responsible for under two-sided risk arrangements. Provides downside risk protection. Null for one-sided risk or full capitation models.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Actual date the VBC arrangement was terminated or withdrawn. Null for active or completed arrangements. Distinct from effective_end_date which is the scheduled end.

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: Business reason for early termination of the VBC arrangement (e.g., 'Poor Financial Performance', 'Provider Withdrawal', 'Regulatory Non-Compliance', 'Mutual Agreement'). Null for arrangements that completed their term.

products.name: aco_provider
products.description: Association entity linking individual providers (by NPI) or provider groups (by TIN) to an ACO arrangement, capturing participation role (primary care, specialist, facility), effective dates, attribution methodology (prospective, retrospective), panel size, and active status. Enables attribution of members to ACO providers for shared savings calculations and quality reporting. Distinct from network_provider (which tracks network participation) — this tracks ACO-specific participation roles.
products.reference: ACO Provider Participation — CMS MSSP TIN/NPI Roster

attributes.name: aco_provider_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the ACO provider association record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Assigns ACO provider‑related expenses and shared‑savings allocations to a cost center for proper accounting.

attributes.name: practice_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary service location or facility where this provider delivers care under the ACO arrangement. Used for geographic attribution and network adequacy.

attributes.name: vbc_arrangement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent ACO arrangement that this provider participates in. Links to the ACO contract or arrangement entity.

attributes.name: attributed_member_count
attributes.description: The number of members currently attributed to this provider for ACO performance measurement and shared savings calculations.

attributes.name: attribution_methodology
attributes.description: The method used to assign members to this provider for ACO performance measurement and shared savings calculations.

attributes.name: care_coordination_tier
attributes.description: The tier level assigned to this provider for care coordination responsibilities and support services within the ACO. Higher tiers indicate greater care management obligations.

attributes.name: cost_efficiency_score
attributes.description: The cost efficiency or resource utilization score for this provider within the ACO arrangement. Used for shared savings calculations. Expressed as a percentage (0.00 to 100.00).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this ACO provider participation record was first created in the system. Audit trail field.

attributes.name: credentialing_status
attributes.description: The credentialing status of this provider for ACO participation. Providers must maintain active credentialing to remain eligible for attribution and shared savings.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date when this provider's participation in the ACO arrangement becomes active and member attribution begins.

attributes.name: ehr_integration_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this provider's EHR system is integrated with the ACO's health information exchange for care coordination and quality reporting. True if integrated.

attributes.name: enrollment_date
attributes.description: The date when the provider formally enrolled or was onboarded into the ACO arrangement. May differ from effective_date if there is a waiting period.

attributes.name: internal_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for internal comments, special instructions, or contextual information about this provider's ACO participation. Not shared externally.

attributes.name: last_credentialing_date
attributes.description: The date when the provider's credentials were last verified for ACO participation. Used to track recredentialing cycles.

attributes.name: last_updated_by
attributes.description: The user ID or system identifier of the person or process that most recently modified this ACO provider participation record. Audit trail field.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this ACO provider participation record was most recently modified. Audit trail field.

attributes.name: next_credentialing_date
attributes.description: The date when the provider's credentials are due for renewal or recredentialing for continued ACO participation.

attributes.name: panel_size_limit
attributes.description: The maximum number of members that can be attributed to this provider under the ACO arrangement. Null if no limit is defined.

attributes.name: participation_role
attributes.description: The functional role this provider plays within the ACO structure. Determines attribution rules and quality measure accountability.

attributes.name: participation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the provider's participation in the ACO arrangement. Determines whether the provider is eligible for attribution and shared savings.

attributes.name: participation_type
attributes.description: The level of financial risk and participation commitment for this provider within the ACO arrangement.

attributes.name: performance_year
attributes.description: The calendar year for which this provider participation record applies. Used for year-over-year performance tracking and historical analysis.

attributes.name: primary_care_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this provider serves as a primary care physician (PCP) for attribution purposes within the ACO. True if the provider is eligible to be an attribution anchor.

attributes.name: provider_npi
attributes.description: The 10-digit National Provider Identifier for the individual provider participating in the ACO. Used when the participant is an individual practitioner.

attributes.name: provider_tin
attributes.description: The 9-digit Tax Identification Number for the provider group or organization participating in the ACO. Used when the participant is a group practice or facility.

attributes.name: quality_reporting_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this provider is required to submit quality measure data as part of ACO performance reporting. True if the provider must report HEDIS or CMS Star measures.

attributes.name: quality_score
attributes.description: The composite quality performance score for this provider within the ACO arrangement. Used for performance-based incentive calculations. Expressed as a percentage (0.00 to 100.00).

attributes.name: risk_sharing_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of financial risk (upside and downside) that this provider assumes under the ACO arrangement. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 25.00 for 25%).

attributes.name: shared_savings_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this provider is eligible to receive shared savings distributions based on ACO performance. True if the provider participates in financial upside.

attributes.name: specialty_code
attributes.description: The primary specialty or taxonomy code for this provider within the ACO context. Used for role-based performance measurement and network adequacy assessment.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: The date when this provider's participation in the ACO arrangement ends. Null if participation is ongoing.

attributes.name: termination_reason_code
attributes.description: The reason code indicating why the provider's participation in the ACO was terminated. Null if participation is active or pending.

attributes.name: vbc_track
attributes.description: The specific CMS MSSP track or value-based care program track that this provider participates in under the ACO arrangement. Determines risk level and savings methodology.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Shared Savings Program (MSSP) Tracks

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: The user ID or system identifier of the person or process that created this ACO provider participation record. Audit trail field.

products.name: exception
products.description: Transactional record of a network adequacy exception or access plan filed with a regulator when a network cannot meet standard adequacy thresholds in a specific geographic area or specialty. Captures exception type (time-distance waiver, rural exception, access plan), affected network, specialty, geographic area, regulatory body (CMS, state DOI), filing date, approval status, approved exception terms, and expiration date. Supports CMS HPMS exception filings and state DOI access plan submissions.
products.reference: CMS Network Adequacy Exception — HPMS Access Plan

attributes.name: exception_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the network adequacy exception record. Primary key.

attributes.name: case_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to appeal.appeal_case. Business justification: Exception Appeal Tracking process records when a member appeals a network exception decision, linking exception to the appeal case.

attributes.name: cms_plan_benefit_package_id
attributes.description: CMS Plan Benefit Package identifier for the specific Medicare Advantage plan affected by this exception.

attributes.name: contract_provider_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.provider_contract. Business justification: Contract exceptions are recorded against the governing provider contract for audit and exception‑management workflows.

attributes.name: health_plan_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the health plan associated with this network adequacy exception, if applicable.

attributes.name: provider_network_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the provider network for which the adequacy exception applies.

attributes.name: affected_member_count
attributes.description: Estimated number of plan members residing in the affected geographic area who may be impacted by the network adequacy gap.

attributes.name: alternative_access_arrangement
attributes.description: Description of alternative access arrangements provided to members in lieu of meeting standard adequacy (e.g., telehealth services, out-of-network reimbursement at in-network rates, transportation assistance).
attributes.references: CMS Alternative Access Standards, State DOI Access Requirements

attributes.name: appeal_decision
attributes.description: Outcome of the appeal process if an appeal was filed: upheld (denial confirmed), overturned (exception granted on appeal), or pending (appeal under review). Null if no appeal filed.
attributes.references: CMS Appeals Decisions, State DOI Administrative Rulings

attributes.name: appeal_filed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether an appeal was filed in response to a denial of this exception request. True if appeal filed, false otherwise.
attributes.references: CMS Appeals Process, State DOI Administrative Procedures

attributes.name: approval_date

products.name: change_event
products.description: Transactional record capturing all material changes to provider network composition — provider additions, terminations (voluntary, for-cause, contract non-renewal, credentialing revocation), tier reassignments, panel status changes, and service area modifications. For terminations, captures termination type, continuity-of-care obligation period, termination reason code, member transition planning, notice date, and member notification status. For all change types, records change type, effective date, impacted provider NPI, change reason, member impact count, and regulatory reporting status. Supports CMS 30-day member notification requirements, state DOI network change and termination notification filings, continuity-of-care compliance under the No Surprises Act, and network stability monitoring. This is the SSOT for all network composition changes including terminations — replaces the need for a separate termination entity.

products.name: vbc_program
products.description: Master entity representing a Value-Based Care (VBC) program design — the template or program structure under which ACO arrangements, pay-for-performance contracts, and shared savings models are organized. Captures program name, program type (MSSP, REACH, commercial P4P, episode-based payment, capitation), sponsoring entity (CMS, state Medicaid, commercial), program year, quality measure set, risk model (upside-only, two-sided), and benchmark methodology. Distinct from aco_arrangement (which is a specific participation instance) — vbc_program is the program definition.
products.reference: CMS Innovation Center VBC Programs — CMMI

attributes.name: vbc_program_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the value-based care program. Primary key.

attributes.name: plan_health_plan_id
attributes.description: add column plan_health_plan_id (BIGINT) with FK to plan.health_plan.health_plan_id - VBC programs operate within specific health plan contexts

attributes.name: attribution_methodology
attributes.description: The method used to assign members or patients to providers or ACOs for performance measurement and accountability.

attributes.name: benchmark_methodology
attributes.description: The method used to calculate the cost or quality benchmark against which performance is measured. PMPM = Per Member Per Month.

attributes.name: benchmark_year
attributes.description: The base year or period used to establish the performance benchmark for this program.

attributes.name: care_coordination_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether participating providers must implement formal care coordination programs as a condition of participation.

attributes.name: cms_program_identifier
attributes.business_glossary_term: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Program Identifier
attributes.description: The official CMS-assigned identifier for this VBC program, used for regulatory reporting and tracking. CMS = Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services.

tag_set.value: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Program Identifier

attributes.name: contact_email
attributes.description: Primary email address for inquiries and communications regarding this VBC program.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this VBC program record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date when this VBC program design becomes active and available for provider participation.

attributes.name: eligible_provider_types
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of provider types eligible to participate in this VBC program (e.g., PCP, Specialist, Hospital, SNF). PCP = Primary Care Provider, SNF = Skilled Nursing Facility.

attributes.name: health_it_requirement
attributes.description: Description of health IT capabilities required for participation (e.g., EHR certification, HIE connectivity, data reporting). EHR = Electronic Health Record, HIE = Health Information Exchange.

attributes.name: internal_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for internal operational notes, special considerations, or program-specific guidance.

attributes.name: last_updated_by
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier of the person or process that last modified this record.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this VBC program record was most recently modified.

attributes.name: line_of_business
attributes.description: The insurance product line or market segment to which this VBC program applies. LOB = Line of Business.

attributes.name: minimum_loss_rate
attributes.description: The minimum percentage loss threshold that must be exceeded before shared losses are assessed. MLR = Minimum Loss Rate. Distinct from Medical Loss Ratio.

attributes.name: minimum_member_threshold
attributes.description: The minimum number of attributed members required for a provider or ACO to participate in or qualify for this VBC program.

attributes.name: minimum_savings_rate
attributes.description: The minimum percentage savings threshold that must be achieved before shared savings are paid. MSR = Minimum Savings Rate.

attributes.name: performance_period_end_date
attributes.description: The date when the performance measurement period for this VBC program ends.

attributes.name: performance_period_start_date
attributes.description: The date when the performance measurement period for this VBC program begins.

attributes.name: program_category
attributes.description: Broad category of value-based arrangement that this program represents. ACO = Accountable Care Organization.
attributes.value_regex: ACO|Bundled Payment|Shared Savings|Pay for Performance|Capitation|Population Health

attributes.name: program_code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier code for the VBC program used across systems and external reporting.

attributes.name: program_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the VBC program objectives, structure, and key features.

attributes.name: program_name
attributes.description: Full business name of the value-based care program.

attributes.name: program_owner
attributes.description: The internal business unit or department responsible for managing and administering this VBC program.

attributes.name: program_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the VBC program.

attributes.name: program_type
attributes.description: Classification of the VBC program model. MSSP = Medicare Shared Savings Program, REACH = Realizing Equity Access and Community Health, NextGen = Next Generation ACO, P4P = Pay for Performance.

attributes.name: program_url
attributes.description: Web address for the program information page, provider portal, or documentation site.

attributes.name: program_year
attributes.description: The calendar or performance year for which this VBC program design is configured.

attributes.name: quality_measure_set
attributes.description: The standardized set of quality measures used to evaluate performance (e.g., HEDIS, STAR, CMS Quality Measures). HEDIS = Healthcare Effectiveness Data and Information Set.

attributes.name: quality_performance_threshold
attributes.description: The minimum quality score threshold required to qualify for shared savings or incentive payments, expressed as a percentage.

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier for the regulatory filing or approval associated with this VBC program.

attributes.name: risk_model
attributes.description: The financial risk arrangement structure. Upside Only = shared savings only, Two-Sided = shared savings and losses, Downside Only = shared losses only.

attributes.name: settlement_frequency
attributes.description: How often financial reconciliation and shared savings/loss settlements are calculated and paid.
