attributes.description: The percentage of losses above benchmark that is shared with participating providers, expressed as a percentage. Null for upside-only models.

attributes.name: shared_savings_rate
attributes.description: The percentage of savings below benchmark that is shared with participating providers, expressed as a percentage (e.g., 50.00 for 50%).

attributes.name: sponsoring_entity
attributes.description: The organization or regulatory body that sponsors and governs this VBC program. CMS = Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: The date when this VBC program design is terminated or discontinued. Null for active programs.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier of the person or process that created this record.

products.name: termination
products.description: Transactional record capturing the formal termination of a provider from a network — including voluntary and involuntary terminations. Records termination type (voluntary, for-cause, contract non-renewal, credentialing revocation), effective date, notice date, termination reason code, member impact count, continuity-of-care obligation period, member notification status, and regulatory reporting status. Supports CMS and state DOI termination notification requirements and continuity-of-care compliance under the No Surprises Act.
products.reference: Provider Termination — No Surprises Act / 42 CFR 422.111

attributes.name: termination_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the provider network termination record. Primary key for the termination entity.

attributes.name: case_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to appeal.appeal_case. Business justification: Termination Appeal Process allows providers or members to appeal a termination; the termination record must reference the related appeal case.

attributes.name: contract_provider_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.provider_contract. Business justification: Termination of network participation is tied to the underlying provider contract; needed for settlement and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Allocates termination settlement and related financial impacts to a cost center for accurate financial statements.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Party that initiated the termination: provider (voluntary), health plan (involuntary), mutual (both parties agreed), or regulatory authority (mandated by state DOI or CMS).

attributes.name: provider_id
attributes.description: Reference to the provider being terminated from the network.

attributes.name: provider_network_id
attributes.description: Reference to the provider network from which the provider is being terminated.

attributes.name: active_treatment_count
attributes.description: Number of members currently in active treatment episodes (e.g., ongoing therapy, pregnancy, post-surgical care) with the terminated provider. These members may be eligible for extended continuity-of-care benefits.

attributes.name: appeal_outcome
attributes.description: Result of the provider appeal: upheld (termination stands), overturned (termination reversed), modified (terms changed), withdrawn (provider withdrew appeal), or pending (not yet resolved).

attributes.name: appeal_resolution_date
attributes.description: Date on which any provider appeal or grievance was resolved. Null if no appeal was filed or if appeal is still pending.

attributes.name: appeals_filed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider filed an appeal or grievance contesting the termination. True = appeal filed; False = no appeal filed.

attributes.name: claims_runout_end_date
attributes.description: Final date through which claims for pre-termination services will be accepted at in-network rates. Calculated as termination effective date plus claims runout period days.

attributes.name: claims_runout_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days after termination effective date during which claims for services rendered prior to termination will be accepted and processed at in-network rates. Typically 90-180 days per contract terms.
attributes.references: Claims Processing Standards, Network Contract Terms

attributes.name: continuity_of_care_end_date
attributes.description: Date through which existing patients may continue to receive in-network benefits from the terminated provider under continuity-of-care provisions. Required under No Surprises Act and state regulations.
attributes.references: No Surprises Act, State DOI Continuity of Care Requirements

attributes.name: contract_end_date
attributes.description: Final date of the underlying provider contract. May differ from termination effective date if contract allows for early termination or extension provisions.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the termination record was first created in the system. Part of audit trail for compliance and operational tracking.

attributes.name: credentialing_related_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the termination was due to credentialing issues such as license revocation, malpractice history, sanctions, or failure to meet credentialing standards. True = credentialing-related; False = other reason.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the provider termination becomes effective and the provider is no longer considered in-network for new services. Critical for claims adjudication and member communication.
attributes.references: Network Contract Standards, CMS Network Adequacy Requirements

attributes.name: financial_settlement_date
attributes.description: Date on which final financial settlement was completed between the health plan and terminated provider.

attributes.name: financial_settlement_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a financial settlement or reconciliation is required between the health plan and provider upon termination. True = settlement required; False = no settlement required. Common for capitated or risk-sharing arrangements.

attributes.name: for_cause_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the termination was for-cause due to contract breach, quality issues, fraud, or other serious violations. True = for-cause termination; False = without-cause termination.

attributes.name: last_updated_by
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier of the person or process that last updated the termination record. Part of audit trail.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the termination record. Part of audit trail for compliance and operational tracking.

attributes.name: member_impact_count
attributes.description: Number of active members assigned to or receiving care from the terminated provider at the time of termination. Used to assess continuity-of-care obligations and member notification requirements.

attributes.name: member_notification_date
attributes.description: Date on which affected members were notified of the provider termination. Required for regulatory compliance tracking.

attributes.name: member_notification_method
attributes.description: Method used to notify affected members of the termination: mail (postal letter), email, member portal, phone call, or multiple channels.

attributes.name: member_notification_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether member notification is required by regulation or contract. True = notification required; False = no notification required. CMS and state DOI regulations mandate notification for certain termination types.
attributes.references: CMS Member Communication Requirements, State DOI Regulations

attributes.name: network_adequacy_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the termination impacts network adequacy standards for time-and-distance or provider-to-member ratios. True = adequacy impact; False = no adequacy impact. Triggers network adequacy re-assessment.
attributes.references: CMS Network Adequacy Standards, State DOI Network Requirements

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, internal notes, or special handling instructions related to the termination. May include details of negotiations, legal considerations, or operational impacts.

attributes.name: notice_date
attributes.description: Date on which formal written notice of termination was provided to the provider or plan, as required by contract terms and regulatory requirements.

attributes.name: npi
attributes.description: Ten-digit unique identifier assigned by CMS to healthcare providers. Denormalized for operational efficiency and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Business-assigned unique reference number for the termination event, used for tracking and correspondence.

attributes.name: provider_directory_removal_date
attributes.description: Date on which the provider was removed from online and printed provider directories. CMS requires directory updates within specified timeframes.

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the specific reason for termination. Examples include quality concerns, credentialing failure, contract breach, provider relocation, retirement, network restructuring, or regulatory action.

attributes.name: reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative explanation of the termination reason, providing context beyond the reason code. May include specific incidents, performance issues, or business rationale.

attributes.name: regulatory_report_date
attributes.description: Date on which the termination was reported to the applicable regulatory authority (state DOI, CMS, NCQA). Required for compliance audit trail.

attributes.name: regulatory_report_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or confirmation code from the regulatory authority acknowledging receipt of the termination report.

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the termination must be reported to regulatory authorities such as state DOI or CMS. True = reporting required; False = no reporting required. For-cause and credentialing-related terminations typically require reporting.
attributes.references: State DOI Reporting Requirements, CMS Oversight Standards

attributes.name: replacement_provider_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the health plan must recruit a replacement provider to maintain network adequacy. True = replacement required; False = no replacement required.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the termination record: pending (awaiting approval), approved (authorized but not yet effective), effective (termination is active), completed (all post-termination obligations fulfilled), cancelled (termination rescinded).

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Classification of the termination event indicating whether it was voluntary (provider-initiated), involuntary (plan-initiated), for-cause (breach or quality issue), contract non-renewal, credentialing revocation, or mutual agreement.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier of the person or process that created the termination record. Part of audit trail.

products.name: par_agreement

attributes.name: provider_id

attributes.name: agreement_number

attributes.name: agreement_scope_description

attributes.name: agreement_type

attributes.name: agreement_version
attributes.description: Version identifier for the agreement document (e.g., v1, v2).

attributes.name: amendment_effective_date

attributes.name: amendment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this record represents an amendment to a prior agreement.

attributes.name: amendment_number
attributes.description: Identifier for the amendment (e.g., A1, A2).

attributes.name: amendment_termination_date
attributes.description: Date the amendment expires, if different from the base agreement.

attributes.name: compliance_status_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agreement meets all applicable regulatory requirements.

attributes.name: contract_reference_number
attributes.description: Reference to the broader provider contract that governs reimbursement terms.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the agreement record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date the agreement becomes binding and in‑force.

attributes.name: electronic_signature_flag
attributes.description: True if the agreement was signed electronically.

attributes.name: last_updated_by
attributes.description: User or system that performed the most recent update.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the agreement record.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free‑form notes or comments about the agreement.

attributes.name: paper_signature_flag
attributes.description: True if the agreement was signed on paper.

attributes.name: provider_credentialing_date
attributes.description: Date the provider completed credentialing for the network.

attributes.name: provider_credentialing_status
attributes.description: Credentialing state of the provider for network participation.

attributes.name: provider_directory_last_verified_date
attributes.description: Date the provider's directory information was last verified.

attributes.name: provider_directory_listing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider is listed in the public network directory.

attributes.name: provider_network_status
attributes.description: Current network participation status of the provider.

attributes.name: provider_participation_role
attributes.description: Role of the provider within the network (e.g., primary care, specialist).

attributes.name: provider_recredentialing_due_date
attributes.description: Next scheduled date for provider re‑credentialing.

attributes.name: provider_tier_assignment
attributes.description: Tier code assigned to the provider within the network (e.g., Tier 1, Tier 2).

attributes.name: regulatory_approval_date
attributes.description: Date the agreement received regulatory approval, if required.

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_reference
attributes.description: Reference number for any required regulatory filing (e.g., CMS network adequacy filing).

attributes.name: renewal_date
attributes.description: Planned date for renewal of the agreement, if applicable.

attributes.name: renewal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agreement is set for automatic renewal.

attributes.name: signature_date
attributes.description: Date the agreement was signed by the provider.

attributes.name: signed_by_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the individual who signed the agreement on behalf of the provider.

attributes.name: signed_by_npi
attributes.description: National Provider Identifier of the signing individual.

attributes.name: signed_by_title
attributes.description: Job title or role of the signing individual.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the agreement.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date the agreement ends, either by expiration or early termination.

attributes.name: termination_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code describing why the agreement was terminated.

attributes.name: termination_reason_description
attributes.description: Free‑text description of the termination reason.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User or system that created the agreement record.

products.name: network_directory_verification

attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider accepting new patients status was verified during this verification event. True if status was confirmed or updated, false if not verified or unable to verify. Critical for member access and network adequacy reporting.

attributes.description: Calculated accuracy score for this verification event, expressed as a percentage (0.00 to 100.00). Represents the proportion of verified fields that were accurate without requiring updates. Used for CMS directory accuracy reporting and network adequacy metrics.

attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider practice address was verified during this verification event. True if address was confirmed or updated, false if not verified or unable to verify.

attributes.description: Calendar quarter for which this verification counts toward CMS quarterly verification compliance requirements. Format YYYY-Q# (e.g., 2024-Q1). Used for regulatory reporting and compliance tracking.

attributes.description: Calendar year for which this verification counts toward annual directory accuracy compliance requirements. Used for regulatory reporting and multi-year trend analysis.

attributes.name: contact_attempt_count

attributes.description: Date of the first contact attempt for this verification cycle. Used to measure time-to-verification and operational efficiency.

attributes.name: provider_response_time_hours
attributes.description: Number of hours between initial contact attempt and provider response. Used to measure provider engagement and operational efficiency. Nullable if provider did not respond.

attributes.name: specialty_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider specialty information was verified during this verification event. True if specialty was confirmed or updated, false if not verified or unable to verify.

attributes.description: User ID or system identifier that last modified this directory verification record. Audit field for accountability and change tracking.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this directory verification record was last modified. Audit field for data lineage and change tracking.

attributes.name: verification_method

attributes.name: verification_status
attributes.description: Outcome of the directory verification attempt. products.name: group_plan_offering
products.description: The set of health plan products offered by an employer group to its eligible employees during a plan year — the single source of truth for what plans are available, how the employer contributes, and what participation rules apply. products.name: group_renewal
products.description: Annual renewal lifecycle record and single source of truth for all group configuration changes — both at renewal and between renewal cycles. Captures renewal effective date, prior year vs renewal year premium rates, rate change percentage, benefit modifications, participation requirement outcomes, renewal status (pending, proposed, accepted, declined), and retention outcome. products.name: group_document

Captures document type, document title, version, effective date, expiration date, storage reference URI, document status, plan year, and ERISA-specific metadata (plan administrator, fiduciary designations, amendment history, trust agreement details, plan year). Consolidates all group documentation including ERISA plan documents — ERISA documents are distinguished by document type classification, not by separate entity. Supports regulatory audit readiness, ERISA fiduciary obligations, DOL reporting, and group servicing.

products.name: regulatory_compliance_record
products.description: This association product captures the compliance relationship between an employer group and a regulatory obligation. It records the compliance status and the date of the most recent assessment for each group‑obligation pair.. Existence Justification: Each employer group must satisfy many regulatory obligations, and each regulatory obligation (e.g., HIPAA, ACA) applies to many employer groups. The insurer tracks compliance status and assessment dates for every group‑obligation pair, creating, updating, and deleting these records as part of ongoing compliance management.

products.name: employer_contract
products.description: This association product represents the contractual relationship between an employer group and a vendor. It captures contract-specific details that exist only in the context of this relationship, linking one employer_group to one vendor per record.. Existence Justification: Employer groups negotiate separate contracts with multiple vendors, and each vendor can serve many employer groups. The contract itself carries attributes such as contract number, effective dates, status, total value, and review schedule, which are not owned by either the employer group or the vendor.

attributes.description: Indicates whether the broker is required to maintain Errors and Omissions (E&O) professional liability insurance as a condition of this agreement.

attributes.name: exclusivity_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is an exclusive agreement where the broker is restricted from selling competing carriers' products in the same market segment and territory.

attributes.name: execution_date
attributes.description: Date on which the broker agreement was formally signed and executed by both parties.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the broker agreement is scheduled to expire. Nullable for open-ended or evergreen agreements that auto-renew.

attributes.name: market_segment
attributes.description: Health insurance market segment that the broker is authorized to sell under this agreement, such as small group, large group, individual, Medicare, Medicaid, or exchange marketplace.

attributes.name: minimum_production_requirement
attributes.description: Minimum annual premium production volume or number of enrolled lives the broker must achieve to maintain active status under this agreement.

attributes.name: non_compete_period_months
attributes.description: Duration in months of the non-compete or non-solicitation clause that applies after termination of this agreement.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments related to the broker agreement, capturing special terms, negotiated exceptions, or administrative remarks.

attributes.name: override_commission_rate
attributes.description: Override or bonus commission rate paid to general agents or managing brokers on production generated by sub-brokers under their hierarchy.

attributes.name: payment_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which commission payments are disbursed to the broker under this agreement.

attributes.name: product_line
attributes.description: Line of health insurance products the broker is authorized to sell under this agreement, such as medical, dental, vision, life, disability, or supplemental coverage.

attributes.name: renewal_commission_rate
attributes.description: Commission rate applicable to renewal business under this agreement, often different from the new business rate.

attributes.name: renewal_date
attributes.description: Next scheduled renewal date for the broker agreement, used for renewal management workflows and commission schedule reviews.

attributes.name: state_of_licensure
attributes.description: Two-letter state code where the broker holds an active insurance producer license, as required for this agreement to be valid.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the broker agreement indicating whether it is draft, active, suspended, terminated, expired, or pending renewal.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Actual date the broker agreement was terminated, if terminated prior to the scheduled expiration date. Null if the agreement has not been terminated.

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: Reason for early termination of the broker agreement, such as voluntary withdrawal, for-cause termination, non-renewal, regulatory action, mutual agreement, or carrier-initiated cancellation.

attributes.name: territory_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the geographic sales territory or service area in which the broker is authorized to operate under this agreement.

products.name: general_agent
products.description: Master reference table for general_agent. Referenced by general_agent_id.

attributes.name: general_agent_id
attributes.description: Primary key for general_agent

attributes.name: parent_ga_general_agent_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier pointing to the parent general agent in a hierarchical GA structure (e.g., a Managing General Agent overseeing sub-GAs). Null for top-level GAs.

attributes.name: address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address line of the general agent's principal place of business as registered with the state insurance department.

attributes.name: address_line2
attributes.description: Secondary address line (suite, floor, unit number) for the general agent's principal place of business.

attributes.name: agent_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the general agent relationship with the health insurer. Drives eligibility to sell and receive commissions.

attributes.name: ahip_certification_year
attributes.description: Plan year (e.g., 2024) for which the general agent's AHIP Medicare certification is valid. AHIP certification must be renewed annually.

attributes.name: ahip_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the general agent holds a current AHIP (America's Health Insurance Plans) Medicare certification, required for selling Medicare Advantage and Part D products.

attributes.name: appointed_lines_of_authority
attributes.description: Comma-delimited list of insurance lines of authority (e.g., Life, Accident & Health, Property) for which the general agent is appointed. Determines which product types the GA may distribute.

attributes.name: appointment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the general agent was formally appointed by the health insurer to sell and distribute health insurance products. Marks the start of the contractual distribution relationship.

attributes.name: background_check_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent background check was completed for the general agent. Used to determine if a refresh is required.

attributes.name: background_check_status
attributes.description: Status of the most recent background check conducted on the general agent organization or its principals. Required for appointment and ongoing compliance.

attributes.name: base_commission_pct
attributes.description: Base commission rate paid to the general agent for direct sales of health insurance products. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0500 = 5.00%).

attributes.name: business_email
attributes.description: Official business email address for the general agent organization. Used for formal correspondence, appointment letters, and commission remittances.

attributes.name: business_phone
attributes.description: Main business telephone number for the general agent organization's office. Used for general correspondence and partner communications.

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City of the general agent's principal place of business.

attributes.name: cms_approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which CMS approval was granted to the general agent for Medicare product distribution. Required for Medicare Advantage and Part D marketing activities.

attributes.name: cms_approved
attributes.description: Indicates whether the general agent has been approved by the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) to market Medicare Advantage and Part D products.

attributes.name: commission_schedule_code
attributes.description: Code referencing the commission schedule or compensation tier applicable to this general agent. Determines base commission rates, override percentages, and bonus eligibility for sold products.

attributes.name: compensation_method
attributes.description: Method by which the general agent is compensated for distribution services. Determines how commission calculations are structured.

attributes.name: contract_effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the general agent agreement (GA contract) became legally effective. May differ from the appointment date.

attributes.name: contract_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the general agent contract is scheduled to expire or renew. Null for evergreen contracts.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the general agent's principal place of business. Typically USA for domestic general agents.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the general agent record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: dba_name
attributes.description: Trade name or doing-business-as name used by the general agent in market-facing communications, if different from the legal name.

attributes.name: distribution_channel
attributes.description: Primary distribution channel through which the general agent markets and sells health insurance products to employer groups and individuals.

attributes.name: e_o_coverage_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of the general agent's E&O professional liability insurance coverage. Minimum coverage thresholds may be required by the insurer or state.

attributes.name: e_o_expiration_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the general agent's E&O professional liability insurance policy. Triggers renewal reminders and may suspend appointment if lapsed.

attributes.name: e_o_insurance_carrier
attributes.description: Name of the insurance carrier providing the general agent's Errors and Omissions (E&O) professional liability coverage. Required for appointment and ongoing compliance.

attributes.name: e_o_policy_number
attributes.description: Policy number of the general agent's Errors and Omissions (E&O) professional liability insurance policy. Tracked for compliance and appointment renewal.

attributes.name: fein
attributes.description: Federal Employer Identification Number in formatted XX-XXXXXXX form. Used for IRS 1099-MISC commission reporting and W-9 compliance.

attributes.name: ga_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code assigned to the general agent by the health insurer or industry registry. Used for cross-system identification and partner communications.

attributes.name: ga_name
attributes.description: Full legal business name of the general agent organization as registered with the state insurance department.

attributes.name: ga_type
attributes.description: Classification of the general agent entity indicating its distribution tier and operational scope. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: general_agent|managing_general_agent|field_marketing_organization|independent_marketing_organization — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: license_expiration_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the general agent's primary state insurance producer license. Triggers renewal reminders and compliance alerts.

attributes.name: license_number
attributes.description: Primary state insurance producer license number for the general agent in their home state. Additional state licenses are tracked in a separate license product.

attributes.name: license_state
attributes.description: Two-letter USPS state code for the state in which the general agent holds their primary insurance producer license (home state).

attributes.name: market_segment
attributes.description: Health insurance market segment(s) in which the general agent is authorized to operate. Drives product eligibility and commission structures.

attributes.name: npi
attributes.description: National Producer Number assigned by the NIPR (National Insurance Producer Registry) uniquely identifying the general agent across all states. Used for appointment verification and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: npn
attributes.description: National Producer Number (NPN) as assigned by the National Insurance Producer Registry (NIPR). Primary regulatory identifier for the general agent used in state filings and CMS submissions.

attributes.name: override_commission_pct
attributes.description: Override commission percentage paid to the general agent on top of base commissions earned by sub-agents or downline brokers. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0200 = 2.00%).

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: ZIP or ZIP+4 postal code for the general agent's principal place of business. Used for geographic territory assignment and state regulatory filings.

attributes.name: primary_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the primary contact at the general agent. Used for commission statements, appointment notices, and regulatory communications.

attributes.name: primary_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the primary business contact person at the general agent organization responsible for day-to-day relationship management.

attributes.name: primary_contact_phone
attributes.description: Primary telephone number for the general agent's main business contact. Used for appointment and commission inquiries.

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter USPS state abbreviation for the general agent's principal place of business. Drives state-specific licensing and regulatory requirements.

attributes.name: sub_agent_count
attributes.description: Number of licensed sub-agents or downline brokers currently operating under this general agent's hierarchy. Used for override commission calculations and capacity planning.

attributes.name: tax_number
attributes.description: Federal Employer Identification Number (EIN) or Tax Identification Number (TIN) assigned to the general agent by the IRS. Required for commission payments and 1099 reporting.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date on which the general agent's appointment with the health insurer was terminated. Null if the appointment is currently active.

attributes.name: territory_states
attributes.description: Comma-delimited list of two-letter state codes representing the geographic territory assigned to the general agent for distribution activities.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the general agent record was most recently modified. Used for change tracking and incremental data processing.

attributes.name: w9_on_file
attributes.description: Indicates whether a valid IRS Form W-9 has been received and is on file for this general agent. Required before commission payments can be issued.

attributes.name: supervising_general_agent_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on general_agent (supervising_general_agent_id)

domains.name: contract
domains.description: Manages provider contracts, reimbursement agreements, capitation arrangements, fee schedules, value-based care (VBC) contracts, ACO agreements, risk-sharing models, contract terms, amendments, and contract lifecycle. Tracks contract effective dates, rate tables, and payment methodologies (fee-for-service, capitation, bundled payments). SSOT for all contractual and reimbursement terms between the health plan and providers.

products.name: party
products.description: Identifies all parties bound by a provider contract — the health plan entity, the contracting provider (individual NPI or organizational NPI), group practice, IPA, ACO, or hospital system. Tracks party role (payer, provider, delegated entity), NPI, TIN, legal entity name, signatory authority, and party effective dates. Supports multi-party and delegated contracting arrangements.

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each party record in the provider contract domain. Serves as the primary key for all contractual party references across the health plan enterprise.
attributes.references: HIPAA Administrative Simplification; CMS Provider Enrollment Standards

attributes.name: contract_provider_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the provider contract this party is bound by. Links the party record to its governing contractual agreement within the contract domain.
attributes.references: CMS Provider Enrollment Standards; NAIC Model Contract Law

attributes.name: record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to credential.credential_record. Business justification: Party represents a provider entity in a contract; linking to its credential record enables tracking of credential status and compliance per party.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.vendor. Business justification: Contract Party Management report requires linking party records to vendor master to identify vendor parties (e.g., TPAs) for compliance and payment processing.

attributes.name: aco_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this party is an Accountable Care Organization (ACO) participating in a value-based care (VBC) arrangement. Triggers ACO-specific contract terms, shared savings calculations, and CMS reporting requirements.
attributes.references: CMS ACO Regulations 42 CFR Part 425; CMS Shared Savings Program; ACA Section 3022

attributes.name: capitation_eligible_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this party is eligible to receive capitation payments (Per Member Per Month - PMPM) under the contract. Drives capitation payment processing and actuarial PMPM rate application.
attributes.references: CMS Capitation Payment Standards; CMS Medicare Advantage Regulations 42 CFR Part 422; NAIC Model Contract Law

attributes.name: contract_party_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier assigned to this party within the contract management system (e.g., Cactus or ProviderSource provider contract number). Used for cross-system reconciliation, EDI transactions, and provider directory publication.
attributes.references: CMS Provider Enrollment; HIPAA EDI Transaction Standards; Provider Management System (Cactus/ProviderSource)

attributes.name: credentialing_date
attributes.description: Date on which the party was most recently credentialed or re-credentialed by the health plan. NCQA requires re-credentialing every 36 months. Used to trigger re-credentialing workflows and network compliance reporting.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards; URAC Standards; CMS Provider Enrollment

attributes.name: credentialing_status
attributes.description: Current credentialing status of the party as maintained in the Provider Management System (Cactus/ProviderSource). Determines whether the party is eligible to provide services to plan members. Credentialing must be current for claims to be adjudicated as in-network.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards; URAC Standards; CMS Provider Enrollment; State DOI Requirements

attributes.name: delegation_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this party is a delegated entity authorized to perform functions on behalf of the health plan (e.g., credentialing, utilization management, claims processing). Triggers delegation oversight and audit requirements per NCQA and state DOI standards.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Delegation Standards; State DOI Delegation Requirements; URAC Standards

attributes.name: delegation_scope
attributes.description: Specifies the functional scope of delegation authority granted to this party. Applicable only when delegation_indicator is true. Defines which health plan functions the delegated entity is authorized to perform on behalf of the payer.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Delegation Standards; State DOI Delegation Requirements; URAC Standards

attributes.name: doing_business_as_name
attributes.description: Trade name or DBA name under which the party operates, if different from the legal entity name. Commonly used for group practices and hospital systems that operate under a brand name distinct from their legal registration.
attributes.references: CMS Provider Enrollment; State DOI Licensing Requirements

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which this party's participation in the contract becomes effective. Drives claims adjudication eligibility windows, network directory publication, and provider credentialing timelines.
attributes.references: CMS Provider Enrollment Standards; NCQA Credentialing Standards; NAIC Model Contract Law

attributes.name: legal_entity_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the contracting party as registered with state or federal authorities. Used for contract execution, credentialing, and regulatory reporting. May be an individual provider name, group practice name, IPA, ACO, or hospital system name.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR Part 162; CMS Provider Enrollment; NAIC Model Law

attributes.name: license_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the party's primary state professional or business license expires. Triggers credentialing re-verification workflows and may result in contract suspension if not renewed. Critical for NCQA and URAC credentialing compliance.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards; URAC Standards; State DOI Licensing Requirements

attributes.name: license_state
attributes.description: Two-letter USPS state abbreviation where the party holds its primary professional or business license. Used for network adequacy reporting, credentialing, and state-specific regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: USPS State Abbreviation Standards; State DOI Licensing Requirements; NCQA Credentialing Standards

attributes.name: line_of_business
attributes.description: Health plan line of business under which this party is contracted. Determines applicable regulatory requirements, reimbursement methodologies, and network adequacy standards. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: commercial|medicare_advantage|medicaid|marketplace|cobra|fehb — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Advantage Regulations 42 CFR Part 422; CMS Medicaid Regulations; ACA Marketplace Rules

attributes.name: malpractice_coverage_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the party maintains active professional liability (malpractice) insurance coverage as required by the contract. Failure to maintain coverage may trigger contract suspension or termination per NCQA credentialing standards.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards; URAC Standards; State DOI Insurance Requirements

attributes.name: malpractice_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the party's professional liability (malpractice) insurance policy expires. Triggers credentialing re-verification and contract compliance monitoring workflows.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards; URAC Standards; State DOI Insurance Requirements

attributes.name: network_participation_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the party is a participating (PAR) in-network provider, a non-participating (non-PAR) provider, or an out-of-network provider. Drives member cost-sharing calculations, claims adjudication rules, and EOB generation.
attributes.references: CMS Network Adequacy Standards; NCQA Network Standards; ACA 45 CFR Part 156

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing supplemental information about the party that does not fit structured attributes. May include contract negotiation notes, special arrangement details, or credentialing exceptions. Classified as confidential due to potential inclusion of sensitive business information.
attributes.references: Enterprise Data Governance Standards; NAIC Model Contract Law

attributes.name: npi
attributes.description: The 10-digit National Provider Identifier assigned by CMS to uniquely identify the provider party. Type 1 NPI for individual providers; Type 2 NPI for organizational providers. Required for all HIPAA-covered transactions including 837 claims and 270/271 eligibility inquiries.
attributes.references: HIPAA NPI Final Rule 45 CFR Part 162.406; CMS NPI Registry; AMA Provider Standards

attributes.name: npi_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the NPI is Type 1 (individual/solo practitioner) or Type 2 (organizational entity such as group practice, hospital, or IPA). Determines credentialing requirements and contract structure.
attributes.references: HIPAA NPI Final Rule 45 CFR Part 162.406; CMS NPI Registry

attributes.name: oig_exclusion_indicator
attributes.business_glossary_term: Office of Inspector General (OIG) Exclusion Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the party appears on the OIG List of Excluded Individuals/Entities (LEIE). Excluded parties are prohibited from participating in Medicare, Medicaid, and other federal healthcare programs. Checked monthly per CMS compliance requirements.
attributes.references: OIG LEIE; 42 USC 1320a-7; CMS Provider Enrollment; HIPAA Compliance

tag_set.value: Office of Inspector General (OIG) Exclusion Indicator

attributes.name: primary_specialty_code
attributes.description: NUCC Health Care Provider Taxonomy Code representing the party's primary clinical specialty. Used for network adequacy analysis, claims routing, prior authorization rules, and provider directory classification.
attributes.references: NUCC Health Care Provider Taxonomy Code Set; CMS Provider Enrollment; HIPAA 45 CFR Part 162

attributes.name: raf_applicable_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether Risk Adjustment Factor (RAF) scoring applies to this party's contract arrangement. Relevant for Medicare Advantage and ACA marketplace contracts where Hierarchical Condition Category (HCC) risk scores drive capitation payments.
attributes.references: CMS Risk Adjustment Regulations 42 CFR Part 422; CMS RAPS/EDPS; ACA Section 1343

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this party record was first created in the data platform. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and compliance reporting requirements. Formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: HIPAA Security Rule 45 CFR Part 164; Enterprise Data Governance Standards; SOC 2 Audit Requirements

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this party record was most recently modified in the data platform. Supports change data capture, audit trail, and SCD Type 2 processing in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: HIPAA Security Rule 45 CFR Part 164; Enterprise Data Governance Standards; SOC 2 Audit Requirements

attributes.name: recredentialing_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the party must complete re-credentialing to maintain active network participation. Calculated as 36 months from the credentialing_date per NCQA standards. Drives automated re-credentialing workflow initiation.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards; URAC Standards; State DOI Requirements

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: Functional role of this party within the contract relationship. Identifies whether the party is the health plan (payer), a contracting provider, a delegated entity, an Independent Practice Association (IPA), an Accountable Care Organization (ACO), a hospital system, or a group practice. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: payer|provider|delegated_entity|ipa|aco|hospital_system|group_practice — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CMS Provider Enrollment; NCQA Credentialing Standards; NAIC Model Law

attributes.name: sanction_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the party has an active sanction, exclusion, or adverse action recorded by OIG, SAM, or state licensing boards. A true value triggers contract suspension review and claims payment hold per CMS and HIPAA compliance requirements.
attributes.references: OIG Exclusion Database; SAM.gov Exclusions; CMS Provider Enrollment; HIPAA 42 CFR Part 1001

attributes.name: secondary_specialty_code
attributes.description: NUCC Health Care Provider Taxonomy Code representing the party's secondary clinical specialty, if applicable. Supports multi-specialty provider contracting and network adequacy reporting.
attributes.references: NUCC Health Care Provider Taxonomy Code Set; CMS Provider Enrollment; HIPAA 45 CFR Part 162

attributes.name: service_area_state
attributes.description: Two-letter USPS state abbreviation representing the primary state in which this party provides services under the contract. Used for network adequacy reporting, state regulatory compliance, and geographic claims routing.
attributes.references: CMS Network Adequacy Standards; State DOI Service Area Requirements; ACA 45 CFR Part 156

attributes.name: service_area_zip_code
attributes.description: Primary ZIP code of the party's principal service location. Used for network adequacy geo-mapping, member-to-provider distance calculations, and CMS network adequacy submissions.
attributes.references: CMS Network Adequacy Standards; NCQA Network Standards; ACA 45 CFR Part 156

attributes.name: signatory_name
attributes.description: Full name of the authorized individual who signed or has authority to sign the contract on behalf of this party. Required for contract execution validation and legal enforceability. Typically the CEO, CMO, or designated contracting officer.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Contract Law; State DOI Contract Requirements; ERISA

attributes.name: signatory_title
attributes.description: Official title or position of the authorized signatory (e.g., Chief Executive Officer, Medical Director, Contracting Officer). Validates the authority level of the individual executing the contract on behalf of the party.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Contract Law; State DOI Contract Requirements

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this party record originated (e.g., Cactus, ProviderSource, Facets, QNXT). Supports data lineage tracking, reconciliation, and ETL audit in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: Enterprise Data Governance Standards; HIPAA Data Integrity Requirements

attributes.name: source_system_party_reference
attributes.description: The native identifier of this party record in the originating operational system (e.g., Cactus provider ID, ProviderSource contract party key). Enables cross-system reconciliation and traceability from the Silver Layer back to the system of record.
attributes.references: Enterprise Data Governance Standards; HIPAA Data Integrity Requirements

attributes.name: state_license_number
attributes.description: State-issued professional or business license number for the contracting party. Required for credentialing verification and network participation. For individual providers, this is the state medical license; for organizations, the state business license or certificate of authority.
attributes.references: State DOI Licensing Requirements; NCQA Credentialing Standards; URAC Standards

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the party within the contract. Indicates whether the party is actively bound by the contract, pending execution, suspended, terminated, or inactive. Drives eligibility verification and claims adjudication routing.
attributes.references: CMS Provider Enrollment Standards; NAIC Model Contract Law; NCQA Credentialing Standards

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date on which this party's participation in the contract ends. Null for open-ended or currently active parties. Used to determine network participation windows, claims payment eligibility, and member notification requirements.
attributes.references: CMS Provider Enrollment Standards; NCQA Credentialing Standards; NAIC Model Contract Law

attributes.name: tin
attributes.description: Federal Tax Identification Number (EIN or SSN) used for payment processing, 1099 reporting, and IRS compliance. Critical for remittance and premium payment routing. Stored as 9-digit numeric string without hyphens.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 1220; HIPAA 45 CFR Part 162; CMS Provider Enrollment

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Classifies the party as an individual (natural person, e.g., solo practitioner with individual NPI) or an organization (legal entity, e.g., group practice, hospital, IPA, ACO). Drives NPI type assignment and credentialing workflow.
attributes.references: HIPAA NPI Final Rule 45 CFR Part 162.406; CMS NPI Registry

attributes.name: vbc_arrangement_type
attributes.description: Specifies the payment methodology or value-based care arrangement type applicable to this party under the contract. Drives reimbursement calculation logic, risk-sharing model application, and financial reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: fee_for_service|capitation|bundled_payment|shared_savings|global_risk — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CMS Value-Based Care Programs; CMS ACO Regulations 42 CFR Part 425; NAIC Model Contract Law

products.name: term
products.description: Defines the specific terms, conditions, obligations, and reimbursement policies within a provider contract. Captures term type (payment methodology, exclusivity, termination clause, audit rights, hold-harmless, indemnification, confidentiality, HIPAA BAA, reimbursement rule), term text, effective date, expiration date, and whether the term is negotiable or standard boilerplate. For reimbursement rule terms: captures policy sub-type (multiple procedure reduction, bilateral procedure, assistant surgeon, global surgery, unbundling rules, place-of-service differential), applicable CPT/HCPCS ranges, reduction percentage, and LOB applicability. Enables granular tracking of contractual obligations, compliance checkpoints, and reimbursement adjudication rules. Bridges contract terms to claims adjudication logic in Facets/QNXT.

attributes.name: term_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for a contract term record in the provider contract management system (Facets/QNXT or Provider Management System). Serves as the primary key for the term entity.

attributes.name: amendment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the contract amendment that introduced or modified this term, if applicable. Null if the term originates from the base contract rather than an amendment.

attributes.name: contract_provider_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent provider contract to which this term belongs. Links the term to its governing contract in the Provider Network Management system.

attributes.name: fee_schedule_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fee schedule associated with this term when payment_methodology is fee_for_service. Links to the rate table governing allowed amounts for procedure codes under this term.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Physician Fee Schedule; Provider Network Management — Cactus/ProviderSource

attributes.name: audit_rights_period_years
attributes.description: The number of years the health plan retains the right to audit provider records under this audit rights term. Typically 7 years per HIPAA and CMS requirements. Applicable when term_type is 'audit_rights'.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR 164.530(j); CMS Medicare Advantage Audit Requirements (42 CFR 422.504); ERISA 29 CFR 2520

attributes.name: auto_renew
attributes.description: Indicates whether this term automatically renews upon expiration without requiring renegotiation (True). Supports contract lifecycle management and renewal notification workflows.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Contract Standards; Provider Network Management — Cactus/ProviderSource

attributes.name: capitation_rate
attributes.description: The Per Member Per Month (PMPM) capitation rate defined by this term when payment_methodology is capitation. Represents the fixed monthly payment per enrolled member to the provider regardless of services rendered. Classified confidential as proprietary pricing.
attributes.references: CMS Capitation Rate Setting Guidelines; NAIC Model Contract Standards

attributes.name: compliance_checkpoint_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for the next compliance review or audit checkpoint associated with this term. Used by the compliance team to track regulatory obligations, CMS audit readiness, and DOI examination preparation.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Advantage Compliance Program Requirements (42 CFR 422.503); State DOI Market Conduct Examination Standards

attributes.name: cpt_range_end
attributes.business_glossary_term: Current Procedural Terminology (CPT) / Healthcare Common Procedure Coding System (HCPCS) Range End
attributes.description: The ending CPT or HCPCS procedure code of the range to which this reimbursement rule term applies. Used in conjunction with cpt_range_start to define the applicable procedure code range for adjudication.
attributes.references: AMA CPT Editorial Panel; CMS HCPCS Level II Coding Guidelines

tag_set.value: Current Procedural Terminology (CPT) / Healthcare Common Procedure Coding System (HCPCS) Range End

attributes.name: cpt_range_start
attributes.business_glossary_term: Current Procedural Terminology (CPT) / Healthcare Common Procedure Coding System (HCPCS) Range Start
attributes.description: The starting CPT or HCPCS procedure code of the range to which this reimbursement rule term applies. Used in conjunction with cpt_range_end to define the applicable procedure code range for adjudication.
attributes.references: AMA CPT Editorial Panel; CMS HCPCS Level II Coding Guidelines

attributes.name: lob_applicability

attributes.name: mac_pricing_basis

attributes.name: renewal_notice_days

attributes.name: risk_sharing_model

attributes.name: source_system_term_ref

attributes.references: Provider Network Management — Cactus/ProviderSource; Core Administration Platform — Facets/QNXT

attributes.name: status

attributes.name: summary

attributes.name: termination_cause_type

attributes.name: termination_notice_days

attributes.name: text

attributes.name: title

attributes.references: NAIC Model Contract Standards; HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164 (BAA requirements); CMS Provider Agreement Guidelines

attributes.name: withhold_percentage

products.name: amendment

Captures amendment number, amendment type (rate change, term modification, LOB addition, network tier change), effective date, reason for amendment, negotiation outcome, approval status, and the specific contract sections modified. Maintains full amendment history for audit and compliance purposes.

attributes.name: amendment_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each provider contract amendment record. Primary key for the amendment entity.

attributes.name: approver_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Needed for Amendment Approval audit; ties each amendment to the employee who approved it, satisfying compliance tracking.

attributes.name: contract_provider_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent provider contract that this amendment modifies. Links the amendment to its originating contract record.

attributes.name: fee_schedule_id

attributes.name: initiating_party

attributes.name: internal_notes

attributes.name: regulatory_mandate_flag

attributes.name: regulatory_reference

attributes.name: retroactive_flag

products.name: fee_schedule

attributes.name: fee_schedule_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the fee schedule record in the contract domain. Primary key for the fee_schedule data product.

attributes.description: Reference to the provider contract under which this fee schedule is established. Links the fee schedule to its governing contractual agreement.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.ledger. Business justification: Fee schedules generate revenue entries that must be posted to a designated ledger for accurate financial statements.

attributes.references: CMS Geographic Practice Cost Indices (GPCI); CMS Medicare Physician Fee Schedule

attributes.name: global_surgery_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether global surgery payment rules apply under this fee schedule, bundling pre-operative, intra-operative, and post-operative services into a single reimbursement amount.
attributes.references: CMS Global Surgery Policy; AMA CPT Global Surgery Guidelines

attributes.name: lob_code
attributes.description: Identifies the Line of Business (LOB) to which this fee schedule applies (e.g., commercial, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, ACA Marketplace, COBRA, FEHB). Determines which member populations and plan types are subject to this fee schedule during adjudication.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Advantage Regulations; ACA Marketplace Standards; NAIC LOB Classification

attributes.name: locality_code
attributes.description: CMS Medicare locality code identifying the geographic pricing area applicable to this fee schedule when geographic_modifier_applicable is True. Used to apply GPCI adjustments to RVU-based rates.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Physician Fee Schedule Locality Codes; CMS GPCI

attributes.name: medicare_crossover_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fee schedule applies to Medicare crossover claims where Medicare is the primary payer and the health plan is the secondary payer. Relevant for Medicare Advantage and Medigap plans.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Secondary Payer (MSP) Regulations; CMS Crossover Claim Guidelines

attributes.name: modifier_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether CPT or HCPCS modifiers affect reimbursement rates under this fee schedule (e.g., modifier 26 for professional component, modifier TC for technical component, modifier 50 for bilateral procedures).
attributes.references: AMA CPT Modifier Guidelines; CMS HCPCS Modifier Codes

attributes.name: outlier_threshold_amt
attributes.description: Dollar threshold above which a claim qualifies as a cost outlier, triggering additional reimbursement beyond the standard DRG or bundled payment. Applicable for institutional fee schedules with outlier payment provisions.
attributes.references: CMS IPPS Outlier Payment Policy; CMS Medicare Outlier Regulations

attributes.name: payment_basis
attributes.description: The methodology used to calculate reimbursement amounts under this fee schedule. Options include: pct_medicare (percentage of Medicare allowable), pct_billed_charges (percentage of provider billed charges), flat_rate (fixed dollar amount per service), rvu_based (Relative Value Unit-based), bundled (bundled payment for episode of care), capitation (per-member per-month), rbp (Reference Based Pricing). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pct_medicare|pct_billed_charges|flat_rate|rvu_based|bundled|capitation|rbp — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Physician Fee Schedule; CMS RBRVS; AMA RVU Guidelines; CMS Bundled Payment Models

attributes.name: payment_basis_pct
attributes.description: The percentage rate applied when payment_basis is 'pct_medicare' or 'pct_billed_charges' (e.g., 110.0000 for 110% of Medicare). Null when payment_basis is flat_rate, rvu_based, bundled, or capitation. Stored as a decimal percentage value.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Physician Fee Schedule; Internal Contracting Policy

attributes.name: prior_authorization_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether Prior Authorization (PA) is required for services reimbursed under this fee schedule. When True, claims must have an approved PA on file before adjudication at the scheduled rates.
attributes.references: CMS Prior Authorization Rules; URAC Utilization Management Standards; Internal UM Policy

attributes.name: referral_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a primary care physician (PCP) referral is required for services covered under this fee schedule. Applicable primarily for HMO and POS plan types.
attributes.references: Internal Plan Design Standards; CMS HMO Regulations

attributes.name: schedule_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the fee schedule within the Core Administration Platform (Facets/QNXT). Used in EDI transactions and cross-system references.
attributes.references: Facets/QNXT Benefits Configuration; HIPAA EDI Standards

attributes.name: schedule_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name identifying the fee schedule (e.g., 'Commercial PPO Professional 2024', 'Medicare Advantage Institutional Q1 2024'). Used for display and reporting in Facets/QNXT Benefits Configuration.
attributes.references: Internal Naming Convention; CMS Fee Schedule Standards

attributes.name: schedule_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the fee schedule. 'draft' indicates under review; 'active' indicates currently in use for adjudication; 'suspended' indicates temporarily inactive; 'terminated' indicates permanently closed; 'superseded' indicates replaced by a newer version.

attributes.name: schedule_type
attributes.description: Categorizes the fee schedule by the type of services covered: professional (physician/practitioner), institutional (hospital/facility), ancillary (therapy/home health), DME (Durable Medical Equipment), lab (laboratory), or pharmacy. Drives claim adjudication logic in Facets/QNXT.
attributes.references: CMS Fee Schedule Classification; AMA CPT Guidelines; CMS DME Fee Schedule

attributes.name: service_category
attributes.description: Broad clinical or administrative category of services covered by this fee schedule (e.g., 'Evaluation and Management', 'Surgery', 'Radiology', 'Pathology', 'Inpatient Facility', 'Outpatient Facility', 'Home Health', 'Behavioral Health'). Supports fee schedule segmentation and reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: evaluation_management|surgery|radiology|pathology|inpatient_facility|outpatient_facility|home_health|behavioral_health|physical_therapy|dme — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: AMA CPT Category Structure; CMS Service Category Classifications

attributes.name: source
attributes.description: Identifies the origin or benchmark source of the fee schedule rates: cms_medicare (based on CMS Medicare fee schedule), cms_medicaid (based on state Medicaid fee schedule), negotiated (directly negotiated with provider), custom (health plan proprietary rates), rbp_benchmark (Reference Based Pricing benchmark).
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Physician Fee Schedule; CMS Medicaid Fee Schedule; Internal Contracting Policy

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code indicating the geographic scope of this fee schedule. Used for state-specific rate variations and regulatory compliance with State Departments of Insurance (DOI) requirements.
attributes.references: USPS State Abbreviation Standards; NAIC State Regulation; State DOI Requirements

attributes.name: stop_loss_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether a stop-loss provision applies to this fee schedule, capping the health plan's reimbursement liability per claim or per member. Relevant for risk-sharing and capitation arrangements.
attributes.references: Internal Contracting Policy; NAIC Stop-Loss Model Act

attributes.name: stop_loss_threshold_amt
attributes.description: Dollar amount per claim or per member above which the stop-loss provision activates, limiting the health plan's reimbursement exposure. Applicable when stop_loss_applicable is True.
attributes.references: Internal Contracting Policy; NAIC Stop-Loss Model Act

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date on which the fee schedule expires and is no longer applicable for claim adjudication. Null indicates an open-ended fee schedule with no defined end date.
attributes.references: CMS Fee Schedule Standards; Internal Contract Lifecycle Management Policy

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this fee schedule record was last modified. Audit field supporting change tracking, data lineage, and regulatory audit requirements.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Audit Policy; HIPAA Security Rule Audit Controls

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version identifier for the fee schedule, enabling tracking of amendments and updates over time (e.g., '1.0', '2.1', '3.0'). Incremented when rates or terms are modified. Supports fee schedule history and audit trail.
attributes.references: Internal Version Control Policy; CMS Fee Schedule Update Cycles

products.name: fee_schedule_rate
products.description: Line-level reimbursement rates within a fee schedule. Each record defines the allowed amount or rate for a specific procedure code (CPT/HCPCS), revenue code, DRG, or service category. Captures procedure code, modifier, place of service, allowed amount, MAC/AWP/WAC reference, RBP rate, effective date, and rate derivation method. Enables adjudication systems to price claims against contracted rates.

attributes.name: fee_schedule_rate_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each fee schedule rate line record in the contract domain. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: contract_provider_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the provider contract under which this fee schedule rate is established. Links the rate line to the governing contractual agreement.

attributes.name: fee_schedule_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent fee schedule header that this rate line belongs to. Links the rate to its governing fee schedule agreement.
attributes.references: CMS Fee Schedule Standards; HIPAA EDI 835 Transaction

attributes.name: prior_rate_fee_schedule_rate_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier pointing to the previous version of this rate record that was superseded by the current record. Enables full rate history chain traversal for audit and compliance purposes.
attributes.references: Internal Contract Lifecycle Management; CMS Audit Requirements

attributes.name: allowed_amount
attributes.description: The contracted allowed amount or maximum reimbursable dollar amount for the specified procedure code, modifier, and place of service combination. This is the principal monetary value used by adjudication systems to price claims against contracted rates. Expressed in USD.
attributes.references: CMS Fee Schedule; HIPAA 835 ERA Transaction; Provider Contract Terms

attributes.name: awp_percent
attributes.description: When rate_derivation_method is AWP_PCT, this field stores the percentage of the Average Wholesale Price (AWP) used to derive the drug or supply reimbursement rate. For example, 0.8500 represents AWP minus 15%. Commonly used in pharmacy and DME fee schedules.
attributes.references: AWP Drug Pricing Standard; CMS Part B Drug Pricing; PBM Contract Terms

attributes.name: bilateral_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rate applies to a bilateral procedure (performed on both sides of the body). When true, the allowed amount may be adjusted per CMS bilateral surgery payment rules (150% of the unilateral rate).
attributes.references: CMS Bilateral Surgery Payment Policy; AMA CPT Bilateral Modifier Guidelines

attributes.name: bundled_payment_amount
attributes.description: Single episode-of-care payment amount covering all services within a defined clinical episode (e.g., joint replacement, maternity). Applicable when payment_methodology is BUNDLED. Supports Value-Based Care (VBC) and ACO payment models.
attributes.references: CMS Bundled Payments for Care Improvement (BPCI); VBC Contract Standards; ACO Agreement Terms

attributes.name: capitation_rate_pmpm
attributes.business_glossary_term: Capitation Rate Per Member Per Month (PMPM)
attributes.description: Fixed monthly payment per enrolled member paid to a provider under a capitation arrangement, regardless of services rendered. Expressed as a Per Member Per Month (PMPM) dollar amount. Applicable only when payment_methodology is CAPITATION.
attributes.references: CMS Capitation Payment Guidelines; NCQA Standards; Provider Contract Terms

tag_set.value: Capitation Rate Per Member Per Month (PMPM)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this fee schedule rate record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and compliance reporting. Conforms to ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX).
attributes.references: HIPAA Audit Requirements; NAIC Record Retention Standards; Internal Data Governance

attributes.name: drg_code
attributes.description: CMS Diagnosis Related Group code used for inpatient hospital reimbursement. When the payment methodology is DRG-based, this code identifies the patient classification group that determines the base payment rate.
attributes.references: CMS MS-DRG Grouper; IPPS Final Rule; ICD-10-CM/PCS

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which this fee schedule rate becomes effective and applicable for claims adjudication. Claims with service dates on or after this date and before the termination_date will be priced using this rate.
attributes.references: CMS Fee Schedule Effective Date Policy; HIPAA EDI 835; Provider Contract Terms

attributes.name: geographic_region
attributes.description: Geographic region or market area to which this rate applies. Rates may vary by state, CMS locality, metropolitan statistical area (MSA), or health plan-defined region. Expressed as a state code, CMS locality code, or internal region identifier.
attributes.references: CMS Geographic Practice Cost Index (GPCI); CMS Locality Codes; State DOI Regulations

attributes.name: global_surgery_days
attributes.description: Number of days in the global surgery period for surgical procedure codes. Defines the pre-operative and post-operative period during which related services are bundled into the surgical payment (0=endoscopic/minor, 10=minor, 90=major surgery).
attributes.references: CMS Global Surgery Policy; AMA CPT Global Period Guidelines; CMS Claims Processing Manual

attributes.name: line_of_business
attributes.description: The Line of Business (LOB) to which this fee schedule rate applies. Rates are often differentiated by LOB as Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial plans have distinct reimbursement structures and regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare/Medicaid Program Requirements; ACA Marketplace Rules; NAIC LOB Classification

attributes.name: mac_amount
attributes.description: The Maximum Allowable Cost (MAC) dollar amount set as the ceiling for reimbursement of a specific drug or service. When rate_derivation_method is MAC, this value represents the maximum the plan will pay regardless of billed charges.
attributes.references: MAC Pricing Policy; CMS Drug Pricing Guidelines; NAIC Model Act

attributes.name: max_units_per_day
attributes.description: Maximum number of units of this procedure code that will be reimbursed per day per member. Used to enforce utilization limits during claims adjudication and prevent overbilling.
attributes.references: CMS National Correct Coding Initiative (NCCI); Claims Editing Standards

attributes.name: max_units_per_year
attributes.description: Maximum number of units of this procedure code that will be reimbursed per benefit year per member. Enforces annual utilization limits during adjudication for services with frequency restrictions.
attributes.references: CMS Benefit Limitation Policy; ACA Essential Health Benefits; Plan Benefit Design

attributes.name: medicare_fee_schedule_pct
attributes.description: When rate_derivation_method is MEDICARE_PCT, this field stores the percentage of the applicable Medicare fee schedule rate used to derive the allowed amount. For example, 1.1500 represents 115% of Medicare. Used for rate benchmarking and contract analytics.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Physician Fee Schedule (MPFS); CMS OPPS; Provider Contract Terms

attributes.name: ncci_edit_indicator
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Correct Coding Initiative (NCCI) Edit Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this procedure code is subject to National Correct Coding Initiative (NCCI) bundling edits during claims adjudication. When true, the adjudication system will apply NCCI column 1/column 2 and mutually exclusive code edits.
attributes.references: CMS National Correct Coding Initiative (NCCI) Policy Manual; HIPAA Claims Processing

tag_set.value: National Correct Coding Initiative (NCCI) Edit Indicator

attributes.name: network_tier
attributes.description: Identifies the provider network tier to which this rate applies. Rates differ by network participation level: IN_NETWORK (contracted), OUT_OF_NETWORK (non-contracted), or tiered preferred network levels (TIER_1, TIER_2, TIER_3, PREFERRED). Drives member cost-sharing calculations.
attributes.references: NCQA Network Adequacy Standards; ACA Network Requirements; Provider Contract Terms

attributes.name: payment_methodology
attributes.description: The reimbursement methodology governing how the provider is paid for this service. FFS=Fee-for-Service (fixed allowed amount per procedure), CAPITATION=fixed PMPM regardless of utilization, BUNDLED=single payment for episode of care, DRG=Diagnosis Related Group inpatient payment, PER_DIEM=daily rate for facility stays, PERCENT_OF_BILLED=percentage of submitted charges, RBP=Reference Based Pricing, CASE_RATE=flat rate per case. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: FFS|CAPITATION|BUNDLED|DRG|PER_DIEM|PERCENT_OF_BILLED|RBP|CASE_RATE — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CMS Reimbursement Methodology; NAIC Model Act; Provider Contract Standards

attributes.name: per_diem_rate
attributes.description: Daily reimbursement rate paid to a facility provider for each day of an inpatient or residential stay. Applicable when payment_methodology is PER_DIEM. May vary by level of care (e.g., ICU vs. medical/surgical).
attributes.references: CMS Inpatient Prospective Payment System; Provider Contract Terms

attributes.name: place_of_service_code
attributes.description: CMS two-digit place of service code indicating the setting where the service was rendered (e.g., 11=Office, 21=Inpatient Hospital, 22=Outpatient Hospital, 23=Emergency Room). Rates may vary by place of service.
attributes.references: CMS Place of Service Code Set; HIPAA 837P Transaction

attributes.name: procedure_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Current Procedural Terminology / Healthcare Common Procedure Coding System (CPT/HCPCS) Procedure Code
attributes.description: The CPT or HCPCS procedure code identifying the specific medical service, procedure, or supply for which this rate applies. Core identifier used in claims adjudication to match services to contracted rates.
attributes.references: AMA CPT Code Set; CMS HCPCS Level II; HIPAA Transaction Standards

tag_set.value: Current Procedural Terminology / Healthcare Common Procedure Coding System (CPT/HCPCS) Procedure Code

attributes.name: procedure_code_type
attributes.description: Classifies the coding system used for the procedure_code field. Distinguishes between CPT (physician services), HCPCS Level II (supplies/DME), CDT (dental), ICD-10-PCS (inpatient procedures), Revenue Code (facility billing), DRG (diagnosis-related group), APC (ambulatory payment classification), or NDC (drug).
